“If you behave correctly, I’ll allow you to watch a movie with me before I go to bed,” he allowed, and his stomach jumped at the thought of a reward in the middle of all that punishment. “If not, you can simply go to bed in the guest bedroom.”

“I’ll be good, s…—no, master,” he promised.

That mocking name he used for him tasted the best in his mouth, and it settled the best inside of his stomach. ‘Sir’ was allowed, and he was sure it was more common, but it still felt wrong to say.

Maybe it was because of ‘master’s teasing origin that it rolled off the tongue easier than something as unfamiliar and professional as ‘sir’, but it just felt a little bit reminiscent of their playful friendship amidst these strict rules and regulations.

Objectively, it was probably worse. Like Mydei said earlier, the name probably had implications that he didn’t quite understand. Masters with their slaves. Masters with their pets. Both of those submissive titles felt wrong for him, but for Mydei? He saw it.

In every part of his body, it just made sense. It felt right.

“Come on.” Mydei’s voice cut through his thoughts. “Hold on to me.”

He picked his body up off of the bed with just a soft grunt of exertion, and Phainon couldn’t help but look up at him in shock. The action was so swift, so sudden, and he barely had the reaction time to grapple an arm around his neck.

“Watch your head. I’ll try not to smack it into the doorframe, but you need to be careful not to do it yourself,” he mused. “Tsk. Even a prince when you’re being punished. I’ve gone soft.”

‘Prince’.

Phainon vaguely remembered being called that when they were in his living room, but to hear it again made his legs squirm. His insides warmed as if he drank a shot of whiskey.

He’s called a girl ‘princess’ before. Years ago when the only things that mattered were sports, grades, and being popular, that was his favorite thing to call his ex-girlfriends. No one ever complained, and he liked the way their faces would heat up into a blush. It was cute.

Never would he have thought being in their shoes felt even better than that, especially if the person calling him that was Mydei.

—

After his bath and their dinner together, as Phainon awkwardly stood in the kitchen wearing a borrowed tank-top and sweatpants, Mydei turned to him.

His best friend had just come back from a shower, having entrusted the clean-up to him as part of his punishment, and was preparing for bed. Once he double-checked his work, gave him a nod of silent approval for keeping things properly separated and nicely tucked away, he held his hand out expectantly. When a moment passed without reaction, his middle fingers curled as if urging him to comply.

“Phone.”

“Mm…”

Phainon’s shoulders sank, and he looked down at the device in his hand longingly, not wanting to part with his silly videos, music, and puzzle games. But there wasn’t a choice.

“Yes, master…”

Mydei took it from him, slipped it into the pocket of his shorts, then grabbed his arm firmly. A gentle pull eased them closer together, closing the space between their bodies.

“Thank you. Now, come watch a movie with me in my room,” he offered him, and Phainon perked up at the mention. “We can watch one of the hero ones you like. I’ve never finished them all.”

That made him lift his head higher.

“They’re all so old now,” he teased him, making the other man roll his eyes. “They were putting those out when we were in school.”

“I was always too busy studying to watch them, but now I have no drive to do so on my own,” he said simply, leaving no room to question him. “Watch one with me, then we’ll head to bed. Or, you can go lay down—”

“—no! Let’s watch one!” Phainon rushed to say. “You have to see the one where the friends reunite! In fact, we can watch them in chronological order in which the universe takes place! I know you’ll understand it better that way!”

Mydei nodded, chuckling softly to himself as he looked away. “Come on. No need to be so excited. One movie, Phainon, because I have to wake up early.”

“Let’s watch them all over time!”

“If you continue to be good, we will watch them all eventually.”

They made their way to his bedroom, flipping off the lights as they passed them and pulling the door shut behind them. Mydei placed his phone on the dresser beside his own, and Phainon instinctively reached for his neck to take his choker off. But all he felt was his own skin when his nails scratched lightly.

Oh. Right. It was taken off already.

He curled into himself, silently looking around the room for his choker while touching his throat. Though he really, really wanted it just for comfort’s sake, it was no longer on the bed where he remembered it being. Both dressers didn’t have it either. Only one held their phones and Mydei’s reading glasses—which made him assume he liked sleeping on the left side of his bed by the window. The other was completely empty on top except for a singular lamp.

His eyes glanced towards the bottom of the bed, to where his blush colored blankets nearly kissed the wooden floor. There was no choker there either.

Mydei didn’t seem none the wiser to his searching as he peeled his bedding apart and laid out a few pillows. A few matched his sheets, and a few looked just like the ones from his guest bedroom.

If they were already in his bed, Phainon realized he must have assumed he’d agree before even asking.

“You don’t have to sleep here, but come lay down,” Mydei said gently.

“Hey, um… Myd… master,” he corrected himself before he could get reprimanded, and Mydei turned around. “Where’s my choker?”

“I put it in the dresser.” His finger pointed to the one on his side, and he rushed to open it up. “Your clothes, choker, and collar are in there.”

Sure enough, a breath of relief left his lips when he saw it, but his attention soon shifted to the collar perched right beside it. Even now, it looked just as intimidating to him. Sat on top of his white t-shirt, the deep red and shiny gold colors made his stomach flutter.

It was so… Mydei.

His best friend loved his reds, blacks, and golds, and he supposedly loved collars with leashes attached to them.

If he wore it, that was probably what Mydei was banking on, to take one look at him and see him as his. Dressed in his colors, in his blatant claim, it probably made this whole ordeal better for him. If not, what did Mydei really gain from helping him with this?

That made him freeze in place.

His best friend was a busy man, but he was taking time away from his usual schedule to do this with him. He was patient, empathetic, and supportive of his exploration, teaching him all that he knows and always looking out for his best interest. This place he created for him was safe while being the right amount of uncomfortable, gentle while being firm, and pleasurable. Everything he did was for him to enjoy and understand this.

But what did he do for him? What did this arrangement give him if he wasn’t taking any kind of personal pleasure or knowledge from this?

If it was just about a collar, any standard black one would do. They could have ran to the nearest adult store and grabbed one off the shelf in all its flimsy, faux leather and fake metal glory. That would have sufficed. It didn’t need to be this elaborate or thought out, and it didn’t need to perfectly match his best friend’s aesthetics.

A collar was a collar, but this was Mydei’s collar, and a submissive was a submissive, but he was Mydei’s submissive.

‘You’re going to be mine for a little while, okay?’

Phainon didn’t realize he had grabbed the neck piece until a clink of metal meeting metal stole his attention. As he looked down at his shaking hand, he noticed that curled within his fist was thick, padded leather. Beneath, dangling uselessly in the air, was the ring meant for a leash attachment.

“Why are you holding that?” Mydei asked him, and he glanced over to him. “Put it down. The more time you waste, the less—”

“Can I try it on?” He cut him off, raising it towards the other man. “You bought this for me, and you’re also doing a lot for me. Don’t you want me to be yours for a little while, master?”

Mydei’s lips sealed shut, unable to rebuke the statement he had explicitly said to him in the past.

“You wanted your claim on my neck, and I… have to get used to it, right?” Phainon reasoned, using his own words against him to press his resolve. “Would I even look good in red?”

“Come here.”

He could have crawled over the bed. He could have taken that shorter route, rolled over to his side, and then stood in front of him. But that’d look clumsy, right? It’d lack finesse.

Instead, he carefully shut the drawer until wood gently thumped to wood, and he walked around the mattress slowly. With every step, he felt Mydei’s watchful gaze.

“Turn around.”

While facing the large window, Phainon looked down at the nighttime bustle beneath them. Even now, he felt Mydei’s presence grow behind him. He had been sitting down, but he knew he was standing even if his bed made no noise. The heat of a body so close was unmistakable.

The glass in front of him was crystal clear except for tall, ceiling to floor beams. They separated the rectangular planes, serving as the only indicator that there was a window there.

It was nauseating. It was dangerous.

He never realized just how high up Mydei’s condo was. As he leaned just a little close, a whisper of anxiety told him that he’d walk right off of the floor into the still-bustling city.

Small twinkles of cherry breaks lay stagnant in the streets below, caught by the matching traffic lights. On the lit up sidewalks, ant-sized people still walked along freely in their evening adventures, minding their own businesses.

That whisper of fear came back slowly, telling him that one look up would expose him for all that he was. This room was dimly lit and higher than all the little shops around them stacked on top of each other, yet they’d see him. They’d see the outline of his body, of Mydei’s body behind him, and they’d know what they did in here. Everyone would.

“Not so close,” Mydei scolded him gently, pulling him back to his chest.

“I won’t touch them,” he promised.

“I don’t care about the fingerprints,” he scoffed quietly. “It’s a gorgeous view, and I’m sure they’re secure, but don’t go testing the weight capacity of these windows.”

Phainon laughed, then jerked his shoulder when he felt Mydei’s hands bring the collar around his neck. “I bet it’s prettier in the morning,” he agreed.

“It is. You should wake up early with me and enjoy it.”

He should.

Was that a kind suggestion as his friend, or was that a thinly veiled demand from his dominant? He had no clue. Was he supposed to?

The first thing Phainon noticed was the kiss of cold metal against his hot skin. Its dangling ring touched between his collarbones lightly, deliberately, settling there for a moment and making itself acquainted with his body. What was just a kiss turned into more as the entirety of the ring flattened out, angled to rest comfortably on top of him.

“Keep going,” he whispered back to him.

Both hands raised as the ring slid higher, leaving his collarbones for a moment to dip into the base of his neck. Now, the soft padding of its inner lining tickled his Adam’s apple, ghosting across his delicate skin before gently pressing down.

Swallowing nervously, Phainon already felt that it was slightly taller and definitely more rigid than his choker. It would take up more space, allow him less movement, and sit heavier on his throat, serving as a constant reminder of his position.

“Don’t stop…” Phainon said, even as his hands raised as if to pull on the accessory. “Master.”

Mydei pulled it tighter, looping one end into its buckle before curling the band completely around his neck.

A gasp ripped itself from his lips, and one finger curled into the ring before weakly pulling. Though it wasn’t enough to choke, it felt different. It felt new.

It was a little bit… scary to know how close he was to choking him, but it was Mydei. Because his best friend was doing it, the experience was also thrilling.

He would never try to choke him… right?

Back to chest, the body behind him stood firm and tall when he backed into him, and Mydei’s nose brushed behind his ear as he exhaled softly. Mint clouded from his lips, crisp and refreshing through the bedroom that reeked of his daily colognes and shampoos.

“Pull harder,” Mydei demanded quietly.

Immediately, his index finger flexed before pulling down on the ring, but it didn’t budge.

Phainon’s other hand reached around him, gripping his best friend’s t-shirt tightly and pulling him stomach to spine next. Nails scratched into the fabric, ripping into the quiet bedroom.

“Harder.”

He pulled again, putting more strength into it. This time it lifted slightly, separating from his skin for a moment to give him more space to breathe. But when he let go, it slithered right back into place.

“You don’t touch this buckle.” The words made him shiver, and his lips trembled as he pulled again without being told to. “If I put this on you, I’ll decide when it comes off.”

“Yes, master.”

A pleased hum followed. “That’s my good boy.”

Pride flooded through his chest and every vein within his body, tingling with life and excitement.

Mydei loosened his collar, allowing it to sag against the base of his neck before the buckle was fully fastened. Two fingers circled around, pushing and pulling to make note of how much space separated the leather from his skin. When satisfied, those two fingers dipped down and jostled against the ring.

Click.

Phainon winced, breaths heavy from all the different feelings welling up inside of him. He pulled on Mydei’s shirt harder, looking up because the thick wall of his collar made it difficult to look that steeply down.

“Who are you, Phainon?” Mydei whispered into his ear, and he screwed his eyes shut.

Click.

“I’m master’s sub…” He answered just as quietly, speaking as if someone else could possibly hear them.

Click.

“Do you like your collar?” He asked, and Phainon nodded quickly. In doing so, the collar shifted on its own, forcing the metal to meet again. “Because I think you look better in red than I do.”

“Yeah, I… I like it. I like being yours.”

His fingers left the ring to push up against the leather, lifting it higher and pressing it closer to the left artery on his neck.

“You’re going to wake up early with me,” he instructed him, and Phainon felt his own heart beating violently against the cushioned leather. “We’re going to the roof to work out and watch the sunrise together, then you’re going to have coffee and breakfast with me. That’s your schedule, remember it.”

“Yes, master,” he agreed.

Mydei let the collar go before settling his palm right over his collarbones. Beneath the leather, he slid the juncture between his thumb and index finger to the base of his neck, holding him firmly and lifting the ring off of his skin.

“But for right now, you’re going to sit handsomely in my bed, and I’m going to search for the lore-accurate beginning of this movie franchise.”

Phainon laughed, unable to hold it back from both the nerves eating away at him and the humor of Mydei’s genuine lack of pop culture knowledge. In the heat of this intense night, it was a refreshing reminder.

“No way Eurypon works you that hard,” he said through his chuckles, and Mydei shrugged, still holding on to him. “First, you don’t know Sanrio. Second, you don’t know superheroes? What’s next? You don’t play video games anymore?”

Mydei had his console hiding somewhere in his home, but he hasn’t seen the handheld device since… when, again? He wasn’t sure.

“I told you, I don’t have the drive to watch movies or television shows on my own. If I wanted to waste hours of my life sitting in the same spot all alone, I’d just sit in my office and work,” he scoffed, though Phainon knew the displeased sound wasn’t directed at him. “Father would love that.”

As Phainon heard one of their phones slip against his wooden nightstand, a thought came to mind. It was fleeting, coming quick and leaving quicker, but it echoed in the back of his head anyway.

Maybe Mydei liked having control in his relationships because he never had any of his own growing up… But he could only laugh at that idea. It was much too sad to give another second of his time.

“What’s so funny?” Mydei huffed suddenly, and he tilted his head back into his shoulder to meet his eyes. “And I thought I told you to sit down? Must you always test my hand?”

“Master’s holding me too tightly, so I can’t go anywhere. Is he scared I’ll run from him?” He joked, and that made him pull his hand away slowly while humming. For a moment, he missed the heat and comforting weight.

“I’m not scared,” he said confidently. “If you run from me, it must be for a good reason. But if I end up catching you, that must mean you’re mine to keep.”

“Creepy…” Phainon teased, then reached to sit down on his bed. “I won’t need to sleep in this, right? It’s so stiff.”

Mydei scoffed again, the sound soft and distant as he scrolled through his phone. “Of course not. I’ll take it off of you when the movie ends.”

“Yes, master.”

He settled into his bed, taking over the rosy pillows and finding a comfortable spot within his bed to lay down. They smelled of Mydei’s shampoo, and it made him hum softly to himself.

“Are you comfortable with my stuff, brat?”

“Mm… yeah.” Phainon grinned. “Try not to fall asleep before I can say ‘good night’. I’ll say it when the movie ends.”

“I’ll be up longer than you will,” Mydei promised him.

“No, I’ll be up longer,” he protested, looking up at him as amber eyes glanced away from his dimmed phone screen. “You’ll sleep first. You always do, you know.”

“I don’t like that know-it-all attitude,” he told him, then pinched the cheek not pressed into his pillow. “Be good.”

Phainon nodded. “I am good,” he insisted, then nuzzled into his pillows as he awaited him to lay down and start their movie.

If he ended up falling asleep over his shoulder to Mydei’s quiet breaths before the movie even reached the halfway mark, then neither of them needed to talk about it in the morning.

The collar became easier to wear since Mydei ‘forced’ him to wear it whenever he visited, even if the clinking noise still tickled him in an uncomfortable way. Each time he moved, the ring jostled. Every time he turned, it swung side to side. That sound was inescapable, but he had to learn how to accept it.

He learned to simply… let it go. If he didn’t think too much about it, or if he just immersed himself in other things, he could appreciate the comforting mark of Mydei’s ownership without the spiral of shame. After all, the collar was comfortable to wear and was meant to help him get in touch with the submissive side of him. Maybe serve as eye candy for Mydei, too.

Phainon caught him looking at it when he thought he was being sneaky, but his gaze was hard to ignore. Those amber eyes were always so intense even if he didn’t mean them to be, like they could pull someone apart within seconds if caught too long.

And waking up to those eyes blinking down at him wasn’t… new. Sharing a bed together wasn’t either.

Being friends since high school, they’ve had their fair share of laying back to back and squeezing into one bed over the years. Every couple of friends did. As adults who both had their own places, however, they didn’t do it nearly as often. Mydei typically went back home at night, and Phainon would borrow his guest bedroom if it was offered to him. There wasn’t really a reason to sleep together anymore.

But then he fell asleep watching that movie, and he was too tired to drive home the night after, so he borrowed Mydei’s expensive bed again while the man washed dishes. Then, again, he slipped into his room to watch another movie a day later, and they had fallen asleep together.

It was comfortable. It was safe. Being next to him made his chest feel fuzzy and his stomach tingle, both in the best ways possible.

One night, while getting his bed ready for them to lay down in, he noticed something that he never did before.

Typically, this was Mydei’s job. His best friend was particular about how his pillows sat and where things went, but he was tasked with it since he was busy. Wrongfully so, as it was only a minute in when he chucked his phone against the headboard by pulling on a pillow.

The device had slipped after clacking loudly. Luckily, it didn’t fall completely down the floor, but what he felt when blindly reaching for it was… interesting.

As he sat by the head of his mattress, pillows pushed back in disarray behind him, Phainon had his eyes set on two black hooks embedded into the bottom of Mydei’s headboard. The gap between the bed and wood revealed them, but they blended in well thanks to the dark decor surrounding them.

He wasn’t stupid. He knew it was for bondage, something Mydei was interested in, but it was surprising nonetheless. Did he do those sorts of things often enough to need hooks inside of his bed?

Phainon, unable to stop himself, slotted a finger into one curiously before pulling to test its strength. When it didn’t budge, his fingertip circled the large opening a few times to gauge its circumference.

There was a lot of space to feed something through it, like a knotted rope or set of chains, and both felt the same when he checked the one across from it. Mydei must have drilled one for each hand.

“Here’s a glass of water. I also…—What are you doing?” The man in question demanded, confusion laced within his voice.

He turned to look over his shoulder, pulling on the hook once more as he looked into his best friend’s eyes.

“I-I uh… dropped my phone down here, and when I picked it up, I found your um… hooks,” he answered honestly. There was no reason to lie to him, not when he made a promise to never do that to him. “Why are there…?”

“Bondage.”

In retrospect, that was a stupid question for him to ask when he already knew that. But maybe he just… hoped for more of an elaborate response, something more than stating the obvious.

Sensing his disappointed reaction, the glass in hand was set on top of a coaster on his dresser, and he took a deep breath before leaning over the bed.

“I feed my ropes through them when tying my partner up,” he explained a little bit more, satiating the curiosity within him. “Or the chain to my handcuffs since they detach.”

Phainon gulped quietly to himself, looking down at the hooks while imagining his own wrists being bound. Would it be so tight that they dig into his skin until his fingers tingled? Or would Mydei treat it like his collar and leave them loose enough for some wiggle room?

Ropes were scratchy with itchy, frayed fibers poking every which way. Wouldn’t it feel uncomfortable curled around such delicate skin? How could someone stomach rubbing up against them for long?

“Why are you asking?” Mydei wondered, watching him while he watched his finger circle the hook again.

Interest flared within him, but like most things they did, as did fear.

Being so vulnerable sounded terrifying. Being bound by anything—rope, leather, or metal— meant he was susceptible to any kind of treatment. He wouldn’t be able to stop someone if he wanted to, and it would be impossible to move if things became too much. All he would be able to do is sit there and be forced to accept whatever someone—no, whatever Mydei wanted to do to him.

There was no ‘someone’ anymore. There was no mysterious dominant and a figurative submissive. It was only him and Mydei.

How could he stomach rubbing his skin against uncomfortable ropes like in the hardware stores? What would Mydei do to him if he had him tied down to his bed and free to touch?

“Phainon, if you want something, you know how you need to ask.” Mydei’s voice was both condescending and encouraging, pushing him to speak rather than stand there and think. “Make a choice. We can watch a movie together, or we can do a little exploration. Regardless, I have about two hours before I need to be in bed.”

The words sat on the tip of his tongue, but his vocal chords were too weak to carry the weight of his request. No sound escaped him besides for his breaths even as he imagined just… asking. Free. Uninhibited. Confident.

“Phainon.”

He looked over to him, embarrassed by the nature of his innate curiosity, and Mydei’s expression hardened slightly. Amber eyes dropped to his trembling mouth and collared neck, then lifted back towards his own cerulean gaze.

“Closed mouths don’t get fed. Speak or starve,” he instructed him, causing his heart to jump inside of his chest.

That tone was absolute. Mydei’s words might as well have been law with the way his jaw dropped as if to speak.

Still, no words left his lips.

“Okay. Lay down,” he said simply. “We’re not doing it.”

Mydei stood upright, then grabbed a few pillows before laying them out against the headboard in the way he liked them. His patient hands peeled the blankets back, grabbed the abandoned remote so it didn’t get launched like his phone did, and turned the television on.

“No, I-I want…” His voice was a weak, pathetic sound that didn’t feel like his at all, and he immediately took one hand to touch his own throat in shock.

“What do you want?” Mydei asked him. “Surely you can elaborate a little more.”

“Master, I want… this,” he said finally.

“Am I supposed to know what ‘this’ means?”

“I wanna try… y-you know…” When Mydei didn’t react, his attention still on the screen in front of him as he typed a movie name in, Phainon’s jaw tightened slightly. “Stop looking at the TV and pay attention to me! I-I’m trying my best to say it!”

Mydei turned, lifting an eyebrow upwards at his sudden outburst.

“I wanna try this,” he stressed, tapping the metal hooks roughly. The impact of his fingers hitting it hurt less than him looking uninterested in what was troubling him so much. “I wanna try bondage, Mydei!”

“Try again.”

Phainon’s stomach fell. His eyes widened in surprise over the immediate shut down.

Mydei’s lip curled, an unimpressed sneer stretching over his face. “Speak to me the way a submissive is meant to speak to their dominant. You don’t have any grounds to demand from me right now, Phainon.”

He shrunk back, glancing between his hands and that heated glare as he tried to quell the nerves bubbling inside of him.

Forcing it out just once was a lot, and having to say such an embarrassing thing again felt a little bit humiliating. Especially when he was being watched so intently.

But he wanted it. He really, really wanted to try it.

“Can I… um… please try bondage with you, master?” He asked him instead, shifting in his place as embarrassment thrummed beneath his skin.

“Better. Do you want me to cuff your wrists to the hooks or tie them up with ropes?” He asked specifically.

“Anything. I-I just want to try it.”

“Don’t say that. Be specific. You don’t mean ‘anything’, so tell me what you want done to you,” he repeated himself. “If you truly mean ‘anything’, you’ll find more than just your hands restrained.”

“Cuffs. I want you to cuff my hands to them,” he forced himself to say, afraid of what he could do with his inexperienced body if given the chance to be creative. “Please, Mydei.”

“Who are you talking to?”

“Master. I meant to say ‘master’.”

A pleased hum followed, accepting his correction. “Fine. Wait here for me.”

He set the remote down, then walked off towards the direction of his closet. When he came back, he held a pair of thick handcuffs and a chain in his hands.

They were laid out before him, placed neatly on the bed in how they were meant to look. Either leather cuff sat on the edges of the lobster-clawed chain, all three spread out for his viewing pleasure.

“Touch them,” Mydei offered, crossing his arms over his chest while nodding towards them. “Feel them.”

It reminded him of when he was given his collar. He was meant to familiarize himself with it, to become less intimidated by their presence.

Shaking fingers grasped one of the cuffs, and he eyed its padded insides before thumbing across the neat stitching. It smelled like clean leather when he brought it closer, reminding him that Mydei disliked the scent of metal on skin. That was probably why he didn’t have the classic pair of metal handcuffs he saw online, the ones police officers carried on their hip.

Truthfully, those were what he expected, not these.

Like his collar, it was thick and heavy. Lined with a nice cushion and decorated with an extra strap to hold a D-ring in place, had this been any bigger, he would have assumed it was a collar too.

Metal kissed his fingertips when he reached, and he picked the connecting chain up before taking in its shiny surface. Upon looking at it, an intrusive thought shot right through his body when the pad of his thumb pulled the claw open, violent and devastating, like a bullet in the chest.

He raised it higher, past the metal ring of the cuff in his opposite hand and towards the one around his neck. But he stopped just before it got too close. Before he could clip it on like some kind of leash, an invisible force pushed him to deny finishing the act.

“Give it to me now,” Mydei decided, and he handed them off wordlessly. “Do you want to be on your back or kneeling for me?”

Phainon looked at him, and he looked down at his hands before humming. “Back, please. I want to see you.”

“Lay down.”

He moved carefully, not wanting to humiliate himself by seeming too eager or too nervous. A pillow was placed behind his head, and he looked up at Mydei as the other man looked down at him.

A nervous laugh bubbled from his lips while he squirmed, sliding himself lower down the bed when his hands knocked the wood. Its sound made his stomach churn.

“Do I look good like this?” He asked, teasing him to ignore the flutters inside of himself. “Have you thought of doing this to me since we started this? You’d enjoy having me at your mercy like some kind of object, wouldn’t you?”

Mydei’s jaw clenched, then eased as he looked towards his awaiting wrists.

“You’re doing it again,” he told him. “Silence, Phainon. If it isn’t a color in your mouth, and if I don’t ask you to, do not speak.”

His lips sealed, and he looked up at his hands as Mydei enclosed the handcuffs around either one.

He let him feel them first, sliding the leather around his delicate wrists without buckling it. They were cool, not yet warmed from the heat of his body, and taller than they had felt in his fingers.

Mydei didn't leave them like that, however. He eased some space between his skin and the equipment, then buckled it carefully. With a tug, he tested their strength. With a finger slotting between, he gauged how tight they were.

One wrist and then the other, he dressed them both in leather, and Phainon bit down on his bottom lip as he looked up at his handiwork. His hands rolled, and his fingers twitched when they were forced lower to the bed. Now that they were on, that meant the chain was next, and Mydei paused before lowering it into his palms.

“Color?”

His back arched off of the bed. His bare feet pressed into the mattress and slid over the soft sheets.

“Did you like it?” He asked softly, staring at his wrists and rubbing his thumb over the hot skin. “Did seeing me in pain like that give you the power kick you crave? Will you touch yourself to my crying face later? I know you’re hard—not that you even mention yourself… Do you think you’re too good to join me in this?”

Mydei paused, resting his thumb just shy of his nipple so as to not overstimulate them.

“Phainon, what are you saying?”

“I-I don’t know. I feel… weird,” he choked out through his already scratchy throat. “My head doesn’t feel like i-it’s attached to my body.”

“It’s okay,” he reassured him. “I’m going to make it all better. All you have to do is sit down and tell me everything you feel.”

“I feel like fucking shit,” he answered, overwhelmed by the mess inside of his body, and Mydei nodded. “I-I look like a mess. Do you… like that? Do you like looking at me when I feel this way?”

The jar was set aside, and he picked another tube up before ripping its sticker off. Upon closer inspection, he recognized it was a small stick of chapstick.

“I like knowing you felt good. Did it feel good for you?” He asked him, cupping his chin before raising the stick to his lips. “Don’t lick your lips. That’s bad for them.”

Phainon turned his head before he could touch his mouth with it, and Mydei stood there in silence for a moment while staring at him.

“Am I ‘handsome’ when I’m all bruised up?”

“It’s light. Your neck won’t mark, and your wrists might be a little bit tender tomorrow from all your pulling, but you won’t see anything tomorrow,” he said instead. “Your chest will hurt for a few days. I want you to take the balm—”

“That’s not what I asked,” he cut him off. “Am I ‘handsome’ when I look like a mess?”

Mydei turned his head, gripping his chin firmly before bringing the chapstick close again. “You are, objectively, a very handsome man,” he brushed off.

That wasn’t what he wanted to hear. Not even close.

“Just answer me, Mydei!” He begged, grabbing him by the shirt before pulling him closer. “Tell me you like it when I feel like garbage! Tell me you think I’m good looking when my face is puffy from sobbing! Tell me these bruises make you happy!”

“Phainon, that’s enough!”

He flinched over the sharp cut of his voice, then sat there as still as stone when he grappled a hand over his bare shoulder to squeeze.

“Calm down and breathe,” he said firmly. “Just relax and take a deep breath. You’re okay.”

“I don’t feel okay!” He cried. “You say that, but I’m so ashamed of myself all the time!”

Everything was disconnected. His head, his heart, his stomach, all of them said different things but they all said it at once. One wanted to come back to reality. One wanted to be a good boy. One wanted to feel ashamed. They fought, tangling into one another and dissecting him into pieces that made no sense separated or put together.

It was like all the leather and chains kept him together in that bed, but without them, he had no clue what to do, how to act, or what to say.

Mydei’s eyes fell for a second, and he nodded slowly before giving his shoulder another squeeze.

“You are my best friend, so I’ll do whatever it takes to make you feel better,” he promised him softly. “Once I finish cleaning you up, I will dress you, we will get you some water and a snack, maybe cool your chest for a little bit, and I’ll let you fall asleep to a movie.”

“What about you?” Phainon asked, hoping he would lay beside him to watch it even if he knew he probably blew that with his attitude. “What will you do when I’m in bed?”

“A lot of things need to be cleaned before I go to bed,” he said simply, clearly not wanting him to worry about it. “I’ll sleep with you when I finish, unless you want some privacy. Maybe you’ll feel better with some time to just… come down on your own.”

Would he?

Phainon hated being alone, but Mydei knew these things better than he did. Maybe he had a point.

“I just… want this sick feeling in my stomach to go away,” he muttered, and Mydei nodded while pulling him into a careful hug, promising that he’ll do his best for him.

‘… Maybe you’ll feel better… on your own.’

Phainon didn’t know what that was supposed to mean. He couldn’t fathom unraveling this mess inside of him without Mydei’s skilled hands and gentle tongue.

Maybe he knew better. Maybe he should just trust him. But it felt… wrong. A voice inside nagged at him, insisting that wasn’t what he wanted even if it might be better.

He never liked to be alone, especially while vulnerable.

That same night, he had fallen asleep while Mydei was in the bathroom cleaning his things, staring outside at the dimly lit skyscrapers. Though the television was on, he wasn’t paying much attention. All it did was cast a bright glow into the bedroom and add a soft chatter to fill the tense quiet.

Most of his bedtime comfort came from the opened bathroom door, from listening to Mydei as he meticulously cleaned the leather cuffs and collar. It was the soft scratches of bristles that made his eyes feel heavy. The occasional flow of the faucet helped him forget about the numb sensation of his chest too. Both being mixed with the exhaustion in his bones made for a drug so strong he didn’t even remember sleeping.

One minute he was wondering why Mydei would ever think he could do this on his own, and the next he was waking up to a warm hand engulfing his shoulder.

Humming, he looked up to find Mydei leaning over him, and two things crossed his mind as his sleepy eyes adjusted to being conscious.

The first was that his nipples hurt.

When his heavy blanket slid over the sensitive buds, he winced, face scrunching up in discomfort. They were more tender than he thought was possible, and it made him shift to lay down his back rather than his side.

The second was that Mydei was dressed as if he had already done his morning work out, and the gleaming sun proved he must have. Its bright, golden rays streamed through the ivory curtains, illuminating the room and the sweat that lightly darkened through his compression shirt.

“G’morning…” He mumbled up at him.

“Good morning, sleeping beauty,” Mydei teased him gently, but it didn’t make him smile or laugh. “Was it nice sleeping in like you used to? It’s almost nine.”

“Mm… Bu’ what ‘bout me?” He asked groggily. “I wanted t-to join you. Mas…—Mydei, we’re supposed to do it together.”

His chest pulled uncomfortably to think the routine they started was broken. The worst part was he didn’t have a say in it either. Mydei decided that all on his own.

That was their thing.

Since that night he first woke up with him as his submissive, they took to the roof and did their daily workouts in the cool morning air together. They talked about their plans for the day while stretching, griped about their coworkers and bosses during simple weight lifting, and pressed each other to keep going when they began to slow down. It was the perfect way to start the day off feeling energized and relaxed, and it doubled as a way to spend more time with Mydei.

His best friend has always been health conscious, so sharing in his work outs meant he could do something he enjoyed the same way Mydei offered to watch movies with him. That made it into a win-win scenario.

Why would Mydei do it without him this time? Did he not want him around anymore?

“I want you to rest today,” his best friend instructed him. “I have lunch to attend with my father for work later, so I won’t be back until the afternoon.”

Phainon looked over his sweaty face and the strands of hair glued to his skin, noticing the rose flush over his slender cheeks and the tip of his nose.

“H… Huh?”

Mydei was leaving him…?

He blinked, staring up at him as Mydei’s hand slid from shoulder to bicep. His touch was hot and comforting, but his head still felt like it wasn't screwed on tight enough to function.

Things weren’t making sense. The dots just weren’t connecting, and everything felt cranked up to a level of overstimulation that he wasn’t familiar with. For someone just waking up, everything already felt like too much—the rejection, the abandonment, the physical aches in his body, the brightness of the morning sun. All of it was too much.

“How is your chest feeling?” Mydei asked, eyes glancing down briefly to assess their physical state before picking back up.

Phainon propped himself up on his elbows, and he met Mydei’s softened gaze.

“You did our thing without me, then… you’re just gonna leave me when I feel like this?” His voice was quiet, but the hurt within his words was loud. It was deafening inside the silent bedroom.

Forget his sore nipples. Forget his stiff neck. Forget whatever physically ailed him at that moment. Those could be fixed with a special little pill called a pain killer and a whole lot of just toughing it out.

What hurt most right now was his heart from the thought—Mydei didn’t want him there to do the things they usually did. Mydei purposefully ignored waking him up so he could have time away from him.

It felt like a punch to his uneasy stomach, and the bruise forming was in the shape of his best friend’s fist.

“I pushed you too far last night. I let our experimenting get too rough, and you ended up dropping pretty hard,” he said, tone solemn and resigned as if that meant anything to him right now. “I didn’t want you up. I wanted you to sleep in.”

Everything in his life had a place. Everything stayed in its place. If it was dirty, it was cleaned right away with no exceptions. If it was broken, it was thrown out to be replaced that same day or fixed as soon as physically possible. That was how he lived.

What about him?

They had one rough night, and suddenly he’s not allowed to spend time with him? Suddenly he’s not allowed to want to spend time with him?

Where was his place? What was he meant to do?

If he was dirty, how could he be cleaned? If he was broken, how could he be fixed? Or… was he the kind of broken that couldn’t be fixed?

The spiral was sickening. It was all consuming in the worst ways, gripping at the edges of his being and pulling him apart.

“De, I-I wanted to join you. That’s not fair,” he told him, but his concern seemed to fall on deaf ears. “I was supposed to be there with you.”

“I only woke you up this early because I finished your breakfast. Eat with me,” he told him gently. “I have a duty to take care of your body, so let me give it a hot meal and some more ointment.”

Phainon’s lips pursed. He glared up at him as Mydei tried to pull his arm gently, and while it was meant to be guiding, to be silently followed like he always allowed it to be, he stood his ground this time.

“You’ll take care of me by leaving me, huh?” He mouthed off, bitter that he also missed the opportunity to talk to him and sneak nibbles as he cooked. “I’m meant to do it all by myself, but you were the one who wanted me like this.”

“Phainon, my lunch is for work,” Mydei stressed. “These are people my father is friends with. I have to show up as both his son and his future successor.”

“You didn’t even wake me up to do our thing together!” He hissed at him, ripping his arm from his grasp. “I wanted to do that with you! I-I like to be close with you outside of just your bedroom, like when we work out and when you cook for me!”

That was his comfort. That was his warmth.

Phainon had found it in him to enjoy being taken care of and told what to do, but only if it meant he still had some semblance of a presence. He didn’t just want some predetermined meal handed to him, he wanted to be there watching Mydei cook it if possible. He didn’t just want to do as he was told, he wanted to be beside him so Mydei could watch him and be proud of him.

Things felt more personal that way.

But Mydei took that away from him. He took that closeness away, and the distance made it feel less like a mutual exchange and more like a dictatorship.

“You needed to rest,” Mydei protested, holding his ground in this disagreement. “I wanted you to try and sleep off your sub-drop. If that didn’t work, I planned to spend all morning trying to make you feel better.”

“You don’t get it,” he spat back. “You don’t get h-how it feels that you touched me, you hurt me for your own sadistic pleasure, and then you just… told me to go fuck off.”

Mydei’s jaw dropped. “I would never say that to my best friend, let alone my submissive during such a vulnerable state, Phainon.”

“‘Come down by myself’,” he reminded him, throwing his previous words from last night into his face. “You wanted to see me cry, then you wanted me to just… deal with the aftermath by myself. You left me here, went about your day without me, a-and now you tell me there’s this lunch you have to attend? So I have to be alone all by myself later, too? When I feel like shit?”

His chest felt tight. There was oxygen in abundance all around them, yet it didn't feel like enough as he sucked in a deep breath and expelled it just as heavily.

“I thought looking out for me was your job?”

“It wasn’t… I mean, I didn’t… do what I did for my own pleasure’s sake,” he tried to reassure him, but even he didn’t seem convinced by his own words. “Everything I did last night, I did with the knowledge you were enjoying it or curious about it. And I’m not neglecting my responsibilities by asking if you need space—some people want space after something heavy. I was only offering it to you.”

‘I didn’t do what I did for my own pleasure’s sake’.

What was that supposed to mean? Did Mydei only put his hands on him because he admitted that he was turned on? Was it not something personal to him too?

The thought that his body meant nothing to him made his chest hurt even more, and his sickened belly shook with a cold, dry laugh.

“You didn’t want to see me like that?” Phainon asked him incredulously, almost amused by his attempt to sound so much more composed than him. “You didn’t like looking at me on your lap like a dog, collared and cuffed, to do as you pleased with?”

A terrible feeling clawed at his chest, one he couldn’t put a name to even if he tried. It tore into his bleeding heart, too big to slip between the spaces of his ribs and free itself. So it stayed.

“Phainon, that’s not—”

“You didn’t enjoy listening to me cry ‘master’ over and over again?”

One hand raised, and he smacked it over the other man’s chest before scraping his nails into his shirt. The fabric bunched and folded underneath his hold, giving him enough to fist within a white knuckled grasp. With a sharp tug, Mydei was thrown downwards into his bed beside him, too stunned by his sudden display of strength to respond.

That lack of a reaction made him even more upset.

“Did you forget that I’m strong too? Did you forget I’m a man too? Did you fool yourself into thinking I’m just some subservient little dog that paws at your chest for treats, rewards, and attention like the others before me?” He pressed him, desperate for something as vicious as his own creeping insecurity. “It isn’t easy to do, you know! But I’m learning how to open up to you, and I tried to stand up to my shame for this pleasure, but suddenly you don’t like it anymore, Mydei? Are you fucking kidding me?”

He was quiet in response, watching his every movement as if analyzing him, and Phainon planted his opposite hand on his own chest.

It hurt. Badly.

Smacking his palm against his nipple stung so much, but he braved through it to make a point. Especially when he tightened his hold enough to make the muscle pudge between his fingers.

“Phainon, don’t—!”

“Didn’t you want full control over me, De?” He lowered his voice, cutting Mydei’s worried gasp off. “That rule you crossed out, the one that said you wanted the freedom to touch me as you pleased, what if I said you could enforce it?”

“Stop talking nonsense,” he snapped at him sharply. “You’re not thinking clearly right now. You’re hurt, and you’re confused, so let me—”

“What if I said you could grab me whenever you wanted while I’m here? You already control when I can cum, so just go the full nine-yards. Touch me like I’m one of your past subs, master,” he encouraged him, squeezing himself tight enough to make the porcelain skin red. “You can grope me when my back is turned, use my body to quench your thirst for sadism, then go fuck off like I’m just some sex toy! It can’t be too different from right now!”

Mydei grabbed his wrist tightly, ripped it from where his palm was rubbing up against his nipple, and looked up at him with a glare.

Before Phainon could even register what was happening, Mydei pulled himself out from under him and rolled over. That hold he had over his stunned figure was stolen, then thrown right back at him as his back hit the bed with a bounce.

A strong hand gripped his wrists tightly, pinning them to the pillows while his other smacked right across his mouth to silence him. It stung beneath his hefty palm, and his fingers twitched from the semi-familiar position of powerlessness.

Mydei’s bare knees were spread around his hips, so he couldn’t even hope to try and kick him off his body. All he could do was squirm, feet sliding to the mattress wildly.

His best friend didn’t speak, but he looked angry. The expression was terrible on his usually neutral face, much like when he had first accused him of being ‘abusive’  to his partners. Eyes narrowed and lips pursed, there was a heat behind his eyes that burned to look into, but there was nowhere else to go. There was nothing else to see.

After working out, he pulled his hair down from his ponytail and prepared to rinse off before truly starting his day. He did it every time. Today was no exception.

With this position, those two-toned locks were draped around him, hanging like a veil to keep his attention locked to his face. The splits within their fiery wall allowed for morning light to spill past, and it chose to highlight his tightened jaw. This time, it wasn’t so easily soothed or released.

Phainon laid there, completely pinned down and silent, staring up at him as the turmoil in his chest worsened.

He wanted to kick. He wanted to fight. He wanted to yell that Mydei was a liar for never being as vulnerable as he was, and he needed to get off of him before he elbowed him right in the teeth.

But he also wanted to relax underneath his warm, comforting scent and let himself be forced to calm down. After all, he didn’t like to be angry or anxious. He didn’t like to say things that could hurt someone else or himself. He just… did. It was his bad habit. No matter how many scoldings he got or punishments were administered, he couldn’t stop.

The hand on his wrist reminded him of those cuffs, and he tried to pull, but it was less forgiving than the leather and chains were. There was no give. There was no space between his skin and Mydei’s fingerprints.

Upon realizing that, Phainon whimpered into his hand, pulling harder as if it’d make a difference.

“I’m not letting you go until you calm down,” he stated firmly.

Tears brimmed his eyes, and he glared up at Mydei while shaking his head quickly in an attempt to push his hand off.

Why wouldn’t he just yell at him? Why wouldn’t he shout back and match just how upset he felt? Why did he have to try so hard to hold his composure all the time?

When it came to schedules and to-do lists, Mydei could be as articulate as ever. He could explain rules, regulations, and expectations all day long with the closest attention to every detail and potential risk. Telling him to wear a collar as long as he was in his home was easy. Telling him to dress a specific way when he visited simply because it pleased him was easy. Telling him he liked the flustered expressions on his face, or the way he looked sitting on top of his lap, was so fucking easy for him.

Why couldn’t he just admit it to his face that he wanted to see him in pain last night? Why was it so difficult for him to admit that he pushed him into this aching, sore state of being because he liked it?

He gave it to him. He didn’t safeword, and he didn’t stop him except when he tightened those clamps too much. Why did he not want that anymore?

He let himself be vulnerable for him, giving him complete power over his tied up body and a peek into the mess hidden behind his skin. Didn’t Mydei want that?

Didn’t he want him?

Tears trickled down the corners of his eyes, and the hand on his mouth slowly lifted for him to gasp brokenly.

“You’re not a sex toy for me, okay? I don’t want that,” Mydei said simply. “That rule was never meant for you.”

“What if… What if we did it?” He asked him in between his shaky breaths, speaking words he never thought he’d say. “What if I said you could have sex with me? Would you change it? Would you treat me like that?”

“No. I don’t want your body if it’s like that,” he repeated.

Phainon should have been relieved. He should have been so happy that his best friend would never force him into something all for the sake of exploration and experimentation. Mydei saw him as him, as someone he loved and cared about, not someone he could just exploit for his own pleasure.

But all he heard was Mydei didn’t want him.

“You don’t want that, Phainon.”

His head shook. His chest trembled.

“I… I don’t want that,” he agreed, and Mydei’s glare eased as he watched him cry. “I don’t want t-to be an object to you, Mydei…”

“You’re not,” he promised him. “You’re not anything close. I’d never treat you that way unless you asked for it—properly.”

The grasp on his wrists loosened, and he gently trailed his fingers down either outstretched arm before cupping his cheek. It was warm and heavy, comforting in the way being touched by him always was too. His thumb brushed by the tear stains, swiping them away.

“I feel like that,” Phainon sniffled, and Mydei’s eyes dropped to his bitten lip. “I feel like y-you don’t want me after I let you touch m-me…”

“Oh, Phainon…”

Mydei rolled over onto his back. His hand reached out for him, and as much as he wanted to keep being mad at him, Phainon followed him obediently.

He leaned into him, resting his head over his heavy arm before allowing himself to be pulled closer. The movement forced him to end up on his chest, cheek pressed to his pec so deeply that he could hear his heart beat. One leg lifted over Mydei’s hip, ankle slipping between his knees. One arm curled around his waist, pulling him as close as physically possible.

Even sweaty, he buried himself into him, holding him as if he’d disappear if he let go.

“Tell me how you think I can help,” Mydei said softly, holding his forearm with the hand not keeping them pressed together. “What can I do to make sure you never feel that way again? Because I’d never just walk out on you like that. You mean too much to me.”

“Don’t go,” he mumbled. “Don’t… leave me out of our things. Don’t p-push me away like I’m not giving you so much of me. Don’t dodge me.”

“I can’t miss that lunch,” he sighed, making him sulk for a moment. “But until I have to get dressed, I’ll spend every moment by your side. What can I do to make this pretty little prince smile again, hm? What do you want to do?”

“Nothing.”

Mydei’s grip tightened on his arm. A deep breath then filled his chest.

“… Nothing?”

His head shook, eyes closing to better listen to his racing heart.

“You don’t want to eat breakfast, then help me tidy the kitchen after? Or we can bake something nice for you to take home later.” He listed all the things they could do, but none struck a desire within him. “We can read. I’ll even read to you. I can pick out an outfit for you to wear for the day, and we can clean ourselves up for the day.”

“Nothing,” he repeated, and Mydei went silent.

“You have to eat. We can do nothing for another… fifteen minutes,” he caved, rubbing his arm softly.

They shifted, repositioning into something just a little more comfortable. As soon as they settled, Mydei gently stroked his arm once again.

“And… just so we’re clear, I need to punish you for what you said about yourself. You understand that, right?” He brought up carefully, and Phainon winced weakly at the mention. “Not right now though. You will kneel while leashed for me, just not now.”

“Yes, m-master…”

“Mm… what a good boy I have,” he said after, sliding his hand higher to gently massage his arm. “Phainon, you try so hard, accept your punishments well, and speak so freely to me. I’m so proud of you.”

His chest ached. “E-Even when I keep messing up? Even when I say things I don’t mean a-and I make you angry?”

“Mistakes are inevitable. Anger is a normal, human emotion,” he brushed off. “We’ll make each other upset, and we’ll both make mistakes. It’s what we do after that matters most, okay?”

Phanon knew that. Somewhere behind this mess inside of him, he knew Mydei was right about this.

It was silly to worry so much about being cast aside or looked down on by him. It was silly to think he would ever be anything less than supportive of him, failures included. That wasn’t him. That wasn’t his Mydei.

Yet his body still considered the possibility of him turning away, and it hurt like hell all over again to imagine it all over again.

“You should stop thinking poorly of yourself,” Mydei told him, forcing him to listen rather than disappear inside of his head. “Being a sub does not mean you’re weak in comparison to me, and it doesn’t make you any less of a man than me.”

His eyes widened, stunned by the sudden words that struck something deep inside of his chest.

“Submission isn’t something born from the absence of strength. To be a ‘submissive’ and to be a ‘weak person’ does not mean the same thing.” Mydei squeezed his arm as if trying to reassure him physically too. “I’ve never viewed you as weaker than me because you decided to give yourself to me. I’ve never seen you as lesser than me because you enjoy being guided and taken care of.”

Shaking fingers curled into his t-shirt again, holding the fabric tightly as he repeated those words inside of his head.

Did he make them out to be the same thing? Was that why he felt so… shameful all the time? So inferior when beside him?

“In fact, I find the idea of submission to be harder than the dominance I practice,” Mydei admitted to him. “It’s… infinitely easier for me to take my sub’s life in my hands and mold it to what I think will benefit them best than it is for them to hand it all over. The strength to let go of your control is not something to be taken lightly. People are not objects. They hurt. They bleed. They break. And when a person breaks, it’s not as easy as ordering a part to fix them or gluing the pieces back together. Yet submissives trust that their dominants will never step out of what’s been discussed to hurt them. Isn’t that strength, Phainon? Don’t you have to be a truly strong person to be able to lay yourself down in front of someone and risk being broken?”

Phainon pulled on his shirt as his next breath fell in a heavy, stuttered pattern, unable to answer him.

“I know it’s hard, and I know it feels a little scary, but is it at least comforting to you, Phainon?” He asked quietly. “When I cook you a meal, does it take away the stress of worrying about what and when to eat? When I dress you up, does it make your day a little bit faster to not spend an hour searching your closet? When I press you to overcome your nerves, does it help you feel more comfortable to voice the things you want or the way you feel? Do you enjoy your submission to me even if it’s still intimidating for you?”

He hesitated before answering, not wanting to get caught up in the pieces of him that were playing tug-of-war with his conscience.

On one half, submission was scary. Being vulnerable was hard, and it made him feel so guilty to get butterflies over collars and tingles over praise of his obedience. This wasn’t ‘normal’. This wasn’t ‘right’. If people found out, they’d see him as a completely different person. They’d see him the way he saw Mydei that night he confronted him—afraid, just a little bit disgusted, and like he was someone else completely.

On the other half, submission felt… good. Mydei was right in all the things he said. It was safe, comforting, and swiped away some of his old stressors. Those things were taken care of for him, and all he had to do was trust they were in his best interest. On top of that, giving up his control and being praised for following an order was what gave him all the butterflies and tingles in the first place.

How could he be ashamed of something he didn’t somewhat enjoy?

Phainon swallowed thickly, coating his dried mouth and vocal chords. “Yeah,” he answered just as softly. “I-It’s comforting since it’s you, Mydei.”

“Good,” he hummed, pleased by the answer. “I want to be someone safe, not someone who comes off as… well, the opposite.”

The word was there, the one he called him when he first pressed him about his lifestyle and choices ignorantly. It started with an ‘A’. It ended with an ‘E’.

‘Abusive’.

Mydei didn’t want to be seen as someone abusive. And because he admitted that he didn’t typically feel disgusted by the things he liked, that meant he had sown that seed of doubt into him by being so thoughtlessly cruel that night.

“You’re not like that,” he promised him, meeting his eyes as they glanced over to him. “You’re a good person, Mydei.”

“Yes, I try to be,” was all he said in response. With it, he pushed the ivory hair from his forehead and admired his face for a moment. “How do you feel?”

“Not… a hundred percent, but not as upset as I was. Thank you.”

“Don’t thank me for taking care of you. I was the one to push you too far,” he hushed him. “I’ll do better for you.”

“Me too,” he promised him, and Mydei nodded in agreement before pushing his head down to his chest again. “Mm…?”

“Lay down and let us hold each other a little bit longer,” he instructed him. “I believe we both need this.”

Who was Phainon to deny his dominant after such an emotional morning? Especially when he was offering him even more time to be close with him?

“Yes, master.”

Mydei sighed softly, wistful in nature. “Good boy.”

—

Even if Phainon insisted on going back home, Mydei told him that he was free to stay and wait for him to come back if he wished. His lunch wouldn’t take long, and if he didn’t have work, then he could spend the day relaxing in his spa tub or watching television in his bed. If he got hungry, he could make himself something so long as it wasn’t a bunch of junk.

Ultimately, because he still felt a little bit uneasy and craved Mydei’s presence, he decided to accept his offer to stay. Though he wasn't physically here, at least his things were around to hold on to.

The first was that his best friend was even more obsessed with organizing his things than he thought, as his closet was divided not only by colors, but by the lengths of each clothing, different fabrics, and their style. Professional things came first, and his leisurely items followed after. Inside of a glass case, each watch, necklace, ring, and earring he owned was kept in its velvet box like a jewelry store. There were no fingerprints on the glass, and he was too nervous to touch and leave any.

The second thing he discovered was the case of his gaming console was tucked inside of a black storage box. He only had a few games, and the device was completely dead when he clicked the power button. But it was perfect. Finding it meant he could charge it, challenge Mydei to a duel like when they were younger, and it’d give them more things to do besides watch TV and talk in the kitchen.

The third and final thing he found was a lock bolted on the right side of a cabinet door. It looked like any other cabinet in here. Sleek, black wood matched his shelves and drawers, even the frame of his full body mirror. But this one was bolted shut. This one held something important enough to need a passcode to get into.

Documents, maybe?

No, he had an office for that. Mydei kept his things together, so important papers would be kept in a locked box inside of his office desk or cabinet.

Expensive jewelry, possibly?

That wasn’t likely either, as he would have put all of his accessories inside of there. Watches and rings that looked like that weren’t cheap, and Mydei didn’t buy cheap things. He chose to splurge on the real deal and upkeep it for years instead of buying multiple lesser quality things that would turn his skin green, fall apart within months, and look gaudy.

Phainon held the burgundy case to his gaming console to his chest, then looked away from the cabinet as heat burned into his cheeks.

He recalled Mydei walking into his closet and coming out with handcuffs and nipple clamps, and that meant this locked cabinet was probably home to his own collection of sex toys. Two were familiar enough after last night, but whatever else he kept was a mystery.

Ropes, for sure, as he mentioned them before. A leash was tucked away in there too, as his collar had come with one but he has yet to see it.
