Did Mydei like to gag his partners so they didn’t get a chance to talk back to him? He said he liked bondage when they discussed their rules, but were gags a part of that?

Upon that thought, he shook his head and turned away from the closed cabinet.

That wasn’t fair, was it? To snoop around and imagine what it was he was hiding away in his own place was so incredibly disrespectful of him. Especially after his best friend had spent a good chunk of his morning trying so hard to make sure he felt okay before taking off.

Mydei deserved his privacy. He deserved to have his secrets.

But… if he was his submissive, then he kind of… possibly… deserved to know, right? Since they were slowly incorporating more sexual things into their dynamic, shouldn’t he know what could potentially be in store for him? It’d be unfair if he came out with some kind of fist-sized gag to shove in his mouth, wouldn’t it?

No.

No, he wouldn't do that. Mydei wasn’t like that.

He was doing it again, wasn’t he? He was making assumptions of him based on his own feelings and running with the idea like it was true.

Mydei always told him to stop, to not say or think things he never mentioned wanting. It was his bad habit, and he needed to curb that. Not because it made him look bad, but because it made Mydei out to be someone he wasn’t. That wasn’t fair to him.

Phainon shut the light off and pulled the door closed, hoping to forget about the cabinet and its contents completely. He plugged the console in by the living room couch, letting it rest on the arm before taking a deep breath.

Well, he had to wait now. What was he meant to do on his own?

Phone in hand, he checked the time real quick, staring at the digits before looking around. Mydei wouldn’t be home for another hour or two. What would he want to do if he were home instead of out with his father?

Laundry, maybe.

There was a full basket in the bathroom from last night. His work out clothes, towels from both of them bathing, his own outfit from when he came over, then whatever they wore last night, all of them needed to be washed. Mydei hated messes, and it would make him happy to see an empty hamper.

He smiled to himself.

Maybe he should also fix his bed too. It was still in disarray from him being in it all morning, and coming home to a clean room would make him happy too.

On that note, could he put his collar on himself? Was he allowed to do that, or was that Mydei’s job only?

Wouldn’t Mydei like to come back to that?

His eyes darted to the phone still in his hand, and he opened their messages. Before he could talk himself out of the idea or come to his senses, he began typing out a text.

> [Phainon: Do you think it’d be okay if I put my collar on myself, De? Feels weird not wearing it while I’m here…]

It wasn’t read right away, but he kept his phone in his back pocket while he got started on making the bed. Soft hums filled the bedroom to the tune of a pop song stuck in his head as shoved the curtains open. With the added light, he smiled, warmed by its rays.

That was when he began picking up the scattered pillows and blankets. Whatever belonged to the guest bedroom, he walked back over to place them down neatly. The ones meant to stay were set on the bench at the foot of his bed to be fluffed and arranged later.

While straightening out the rust-colored sheets, his phone buzzed.

At the same moment he looked down to his notifications, Phainon chuckled to himself. What was that thing Mydei told him before?

Something… Something… ‘Don’t forget to text me back’, right?

> [Mydei: Do you want to wear it?]

It was surprising to him too, but he craved the leather like it’d somehow give him the strength to do more. Like it held all the answers of what to do while waiting for him.

> [Phainon: Yeah… Is that bad?]

Was that embarrassing to admit to him? Was that something he should want without Mydei prompting it?

> [Mydei: No. You should never be ashamed of your submission. But I want you to show me. Right now.]

Phainon made his way to the dresser, and he pulled open the top drawer slowly. Leather brushed his fingertips when he reached for it. Metal chilled his touch when he grabbed it.

The buckle was worked open, and a shaky breath fell from his lips as he fit the collar around his neck. Its ring softly clicked as he jostled it, and he might have closed it one hole tighter than Mydei did, but the weight felt good. The tightness felt good. Just having it on and feeling it hug his throat made his stomach tingle and palms sweat.

Forget using cakes to Pavlov him into obedience. Did Mydei train him to get excited when he put a collar on?

His hand shook just a little while holding his camera up, and he held down the button on it before showing him his handiwork. One finger pulled on the ring, letting him see how tight and secure it was, then dropped it so he could see his bare collarbones and collared neck.

When the video was sent, it was read immediately. Clearly, Mydei was waiting for it.

> [Mydei: That’s my good boy. Is your chest okay? I can see you’re not wearing a shirt.]

A smile tugged on his lips as he read the text over again, warm from his concern over his health. Even when faced with a video like that, he was still worried about his body.

> [Phainon: It’s sore, but I’ll be okay.]

> [Mydei: I can’t hide out in the bathroom forever, so I’ll see you soon. Don’t take your collar off, understand? I want to come home to my handsome, collared prince.]

Phainon dropped his phone onto the bed, and he covered his mouth with one hand while staring down at the message. His breaths were slightly labored. Warmth burned inside of his cheeks over being told Mydei wanted to ‘come home’ to him.

Did he even realize what that sounded like or what that implied? How common was it for him to tell his submissives that?

Another buzz vibrated through the room, and he noticed another text pop up.

> [Mydei: Re-apply the balm for me while you’re up. Take care of yourself until I can.]

He picked his phone up, mumbling softly to himself as he swiped out the only response he could think of.

> [Phainon: Yes, master.]

It was read upon delivery, but without a response, he assumed Mydei had gone back to his table to talk about whatever business his father needed him so desperately for. Which was fine. He didn’t want to keep him away from his job.

A deep breath followed as he fell back onto the bed beside him. Butterflies filled his stomach and chest, taking up the space in his lungs.

“Stupid Mydei,” he muttered to himself, eyes glued to the ceiling. “Why does he have to say such weird things so casually?”

And why did he like the idea of playing house much?

—

When Mydei came back, Phainon had just finished sorting the clothes into piles on his bed. His body was sprawled out on the couch as the front door opened, back flat to the cushions of his couch and arms raised overhead. One leg was bent at the knee, foot pressed to the edge of the cushion while his opposite leg bent off of the end. The epitome of comfort. The embodiment of relaxation.

He was practicing his character combos for when he asked to duel Mydei, eyes zeroed in on the screen and fingers smashing the buttons. They clicked loudly, overtaking the lowered volume of the game itself.

Crinkled bags and the heat of a watchful gaze made him shift, his attention stolen by the man with a couple shopping bags in his hand. His shoes were off, not wanting to track dirt throughout his clean home. His sunglasses sat where his bangs separated from the rest of his hair, unneeded now that he was indoors.

They looked at each other in silence for another moment, and as interested as he had been in his video game, Phainon shut the device off and sat up. His collar clinked as the ring moved, and he shifted to accommodate its stiff length.

“Hey. Welcome back,” he greeted him kindly, sitting up but not quite moving from his spot on the couch. “What’s all that?”

“H-Hey,” Mydei stammered out, still staring at him. He then glanced away from him briefly, fist to his mouth while clearing his throat. “Hey. I stopped by some of the shops near the restaurant we went to, so… Come here and look.”

His snowy eyebrow lifted, but he picked himself up as he was told to. Quiet but swift steps carried him over, arms tucked behind his back so they didn’t sway by his sides.

Amber eyes dropped from his face to the bare skin of his upper body. They moved much more blatantly than he probably meant them to be, dragging left to right over his chest and shoulders before travelling back up the column of his throat. His Adam’s apple bobbed, an audible swallow filling between them.

“De, you’re shameless,” he teased him, hot under his skin from being checked out. “I’m not shirtless just because I felt like it, you know.”

“Thinking about this wasn’t the same as seeing it with my own eyes,” Mydei defended himself, and Phainon’s cocky grin twitched downwards.

There he went again saying and implying things that he wasn’t used to hearing…

“You… uh… were thinking about it?” He asked, not feeling as confident as he had been in the face of his confession. “You were thinking of me being here, half naked and collared, as I waited for you?”

“I promised not to lie.”

That was true. They promised to be honest with one another, to be open with their thoughts and feelings, even if it was difficult or something slightly humiliating. It would keep them safe. It would keep their arrangement from twisting into something that could be non-consensual.

They were meant to practice honesty. He was meant to find comfort within his vulnerability, and Mydei was meant to be the security that kept it going.

“On that note, I guess I… was also thinking about you coming back to me like this…” Phainon confessed as well, awkwardness swimming through his words.

They looked at each other, and as he laughed nervously, Mydei’s lips curled into a kind smile. Soft chuckles slowly shook his chest, joining him in his attempt to dispel the weight of their confessions.

“What did you do while I was gone?” He asked him, keeping his eyes above his neck now that he got it out of his system. “Have you been playing games this whole time?”

“Actually, I cleaned up,” he corrected him. “I made the bed, and I washed our clothes inside the hamper. They’re folded in your room right now, so will you show me how to put them away? I didn’t wanna mess up the whole… thing you have going on in there. It looks a little too complicated.”

Mydei cocked his head to the side slightly, and he silently made his way to his bedroom as if he wanted to see the work for himself. As if he didn’t believe what he was hearing.

Nerves and fear bubbled within Phainon’s stomach at the thought of being scolded for possibly overstepping a boundary. His fingers twiddled themselves, tapping nail to nail before spinning around one another aimlessly. With his gaze pointed towards them, he tried to save himself from humiliation if Mydei were to be upset at him.

A soft grunt left his lips when he bumped into him, having followed without being told to. He didn’t notice the stillness of the other man until after they collided weakly.

“You… wanted to do that?” Mydei confirmed.

He shrugged. “I mean… you let me stay here while you were gone, and I can’t just run your bills up for free. I ate your food and took a pretty long bath, so I cleaned up a little bit.”

“You don’t have to worry about my bills,” Mydei mused, turning to face him. “You don’t have to worry about keeping yourself busy with me. I keep myself busy so you can relax comfortably. All I ask is that you look after yourself when I cannot.”

Warmth soon engulfed his cheeks, forcing him to look up as two hands lifted his attention higher. His mouth was slightly squished from their firm press.

“Thank you, Phainon.”

Immediately, he grinned, then shrugged to brush off the spark of pride inside of him. “It’s no big deal. I mean, I had the time…”

Appreciation for his efforts felt good. It felt so good that he wanted to do it all over again just to see that look on his face again.

“You really are such a sweet boy for me,” he praised him, and Phainon bit down on his tongue to keep from making any kind of embarrassing noise. “Thank you for waiting for me to put them away too. That’s much more helpful than forcing things into a spot they don’t belong in.”

“Everything has a place, and everything should be in its place,” he recited, earning a raised eyebrow in return. “I… know you. I know what you’re like, and as nice as doing laundry is, I know it would have stressed you out to see your things not organized to your liking. Plus… we could do it together, and you could then show me for the future. Win-win, right?"

Mydei’s eyes widened slightly. Rose tinted his cheeks the same color of his hair.

“You’re the first person to think like that,” he admitted quietly. “Usually people just put things wherever and pray it works out. The gesture is there, but it ends up just being more work on me.”

“Well, I’ve only known you all our lives…”

He let go of him, then looked down to the bags still hanging on his wrists.

“Before we put them away, I want you to open this,” he told him. “I got a few things for you.”

Guilt pooled within his stomach at the thought of him spending money on stuff he didn’t need, but he reached his hands out anyway to take the bag offered. It was rude to refuse gifts, so now that it was bought, it would be disrespectful to turn it down.

He really knew how to get around that, didn’t he?

“I know I said you needed to be punished, and that will come. I haven’t forgotten,” he started his explanation off. “But, I believe you deserve a… reward. A confirmation that I see your effort. Though you struggle with holding your tongue and depreciating yourself, I can’t help but want to reward your ability to be completely honest with me. Negative or not, honesty is honesty, and it helps me understand you better.”

“Mydei, you didn’t… This is my part to play, isn’t it?” He reasoned. “You shouldn’t reward me for doing as I promised. This is my half of our arrangement, so… I don’t deserve this.”

“You deserve to have your efforts acknowledged. Verbally is fine, but physical proof is always nice,” he insisted softly.

Phainon took the bag being offered to him, then reached inside to pull out a few pairs of jeans. The top one was dyed a deep black, much like the ones Mydei liked. Beneath was a blue color much more reminiscent of his own closet, proving he didn’t just grab things. He thought of him and what he liked to wear, not just what he wore for him.

One pair for Mydei to further submit himself to him, and another pair for him to enjoy himself and his own fashion sense.

“Are you calling my fashion taste bad with this?” He joked, earning a roll of the eyes.

“I’m saying you look good in black,” he corrected him. “Wear it more often for me, so even when you’re turning heads, you’re submitting to me.”

“Is that an order from my master, or a request from my oh-so fashionable best friend?” He asked, taking in his button-down, tie, and dark gray trousers.

Mydei’s lip curled, and his tongue traced over his top teeth slowly. “That’s an order from your master, pretty boy.”

Phainon’s breaths hitched over the name, and he gripped the clothes tighter while his best friend took a step closer into his personal space.

“You should always want to dress for my interest,” he chided, lifting the black pair up to his chest carefully. “Your own closet is charming, but I like you dressed in black and blushing down your chest.”

“I… I um…” He stammered, then looked away as his finger slowly dragged along the crisp denim to keep from touching his skin. “M-Mydei, what are you…?”

He couldn’t feel it completely, but the phantom drag of his soft fingertips gripping and groping his body made his heartbeat pick up even more. It was as if he could make out the divots of his fingerprints or the scratch of his trimmed nails through such thick clothes.

The closer his finger got to the top of the jeans, the more his chin lifted, anticipating him to then touch his neck like he usually enjoyed doing.

“Mm… I’m sorry. I was just reminded of last night and how handsome you looked,” he apologized. When he pulled his hand back, he watched as his lack of presence caused the pants to fall back into his arms. “Let's put these clothes away. I want to hear about your day.”

Exhaling, Phainon watched as his eyes glinted with something both playful and dark.

“I won’t touch you anymore today,” he promised him. “You are not an object, and I’m not trying to push you anymore than I did.”

Was that what people meant when calling someone a tease?

“Master…”

“Awh,” he mused. “Don’t look at me with such a needy look in your eyes, or I’ll get the wrong idea. You look good begging.”

Phainon shook his head to wipe every thought clean, and Mydei picked the discarded bag up before walking towards his bed.

“You can take your clothes back in this bag,” he allowed, setting them neatly inside. “I will give you a t-shirt to go home in, one loose enough to not agitate your chest.”

Beside them, he placed the newest addition to his closet down and then looked over to Mydei.

“Can I… ask you something?” He asked nervously, picking up his cleaned gym clothes. “There’s a cabinet in your closet… What’s the lock for?”

“Did this naughty boy go snooping through his master’s things?” He huffed. “You sure do have a way of burying yourself into my business, don’t you?”

“Well…—”

“I keep my gear in there.” Phainon guessed as much. “Do you want to see my collection? You have a look that says you’re dying to know what’s in it.”

“I don’t want to do anything sexual,” he admitted to him. Despite craving his touch just moments ago, he wasn’t sure if he had it in him to be touched all over again like last night. “My chest still hurts, a-and I still don’t feel the best inside, you know?”

He followed Mydei to his closet silently, then watched as he pulled open a drawer full of other sweatpants and lounging shirts.

“I didn’t ask if you wanted to play, I asked if you wanted to see them,” he repeated himself. “Behind. Dark clothes go in front of the brighter ones, because things in the front are easier to see.”

Phainon nodded, squatting down to tuck the black top with the rest of them neatly.

“Those sweats have a cuff at the bottom. They cannot go with the ones that don’t. They’re different kinds of pants. But they’re gray, so they go in front of white but behind black.”

They were placed with the others when pointed out, and he looked up at him for guidance once he finished.

“It’s a complicated system. This is why you don’t need to worry about it,” Mydei told him. “I appreciate it though.”

“I’ll learn,” he reassured him, not thinking much of it. “I’ll learn how you do things, De. You can have all the responsibility you want, but it’s nice to have a little bit of help, right? Come on. I can put clothes away.”

His expression and tone didn’t change. “It’s a lot to ask of you.”

“It can’t be more difficult than anything else you’re asking of me,” he mused, standing upright to take the clothes in his hands. “I mean, you said no one’s done this. Do you not bother with teaching them this part, or do they just not ask to learn?”

“Hm…”

The answer was silent, and Phainon nodded, accepting the answer as is.

“If I call you ‘master’ again, will you show me how you organize your work pants?” He asked him hopefully.

“Alright. Listen and listen well,” Mydei caved, pointing to a segment of his closet full of hung up pants. “It makes me upset if things aren’t kept where I need them to be, and I don’t like looking for them. It’s all a waste of time.”

He knew that, and he made sure to pay close attention to how he liked to separate them. Same with his shirts.

Truthfully, it was a lot. Mydei wasn't lying.

To him, a shirt was a shirt and pants were pants. Unless they had special instructions for care, or very clearly didn’t belong in the same drawer, they all ended up in the same place. Jeans were stacked on sweats. His undershirts were next to his going out shirts. It didn’t matter.

But Mydei cared. He cared a lot, so he wanted to at least try to understand his particular taste before agreeing whether or not it was too much to take. And even if it did prove to be too much, he just needed time to learn how to get it right.

“If I mess this up, will my master punish me?” He wondered casually, and Mydei took a deep breath.

“Do you want me to? We agreed to experiment, not… this.”

What was ‘this’? Was it not just a submissive helping his dominant? A friend helping his friend?

“Well, you have so many office supplies and copies of your rules. Put a sticky note on it or write it on a spare copy,” he told him simply. “Write, ‘Phainon will learn how to be a better sub for his master’, or something. That’s what this is, isn't it? Serving you?”

“Technically, it is…” He agreed, sounding deep in thought. “Do you really want to do this kind of thing with me too? This… domestic service?”

Phainon looked over to him, and Mydei looked back with an expression he didn’t quite recognize.

“I mean… it’s part of your whole gig, right?” He asked. “Even if it’s not, as your friend who’s staying over a lot more, isn’t it good for me to know?”

It didn’t seem like he needed much convincing past that.

“Okay. We can add it in.”

A tingle tickled through his body, inching from the depths of his stomach and towards his fingers, toes, and chest. It was warm, slightly sinking as if he signed even more of his freedom away, but also a little bit thrilling. Like a rollercoaster ride that made him want to throw up but laugh in joy.

“Do you still want to look at my gear?” Mydei took a step closer to the keypad. “I can’t promise you’ll like what you see, but I’ll explain it all for you.”

He wanted to.

All of him wanted to quell that curiosity inside of him, the one that wondered what Mydei was like when he wasn’t coddling his sensitive feelings.

He liked boys who cried. He liked watching them get flustered, squirm, and crack underneath the pleasure and pain. As kind as he was outside of bed, it seemed he liked things just a little rougher than he let on.

What exactly did he hide in there?

But his stomach churned slightly when he was reminded of that terrible feeling of inadequacy and anxiety after. It made him feel as if he was being pulled apart from the inside, and it caused him to lash out.

Maybe he wasn’t ready to look at that yet. Maybe he needed a little bit longer to gather his feelings and keep ‘coming down’ from his ‘sub-drop’, as his best friend called it.

“Can we play video games?” He asked instead, and Mydei eased his hand away from the keypad. “I’ve been practicing, and I want to see who’s better.”

His best friend nodded, turning away from his trove of BDSM equipment to instead guide him towards the door. Not that he needed to when he was already walking out.

“I haven't played in awhile, so let me practice a little bit before we do,” Mydei agreed, following him out as he rushed to the living room. “Slow down! The console won’t run away from you, Phainon!”

“Awh, but master, I can’t wait to finally be the one to teach you something,” he taunted him.

He turned around to face him as he walked slowly from his bedroom and through the hallway towards him, grinning widely.

“So slow!”

“You shouldn’t run in other people’s homes. Were you raised in a barn?”

“A farm,” he answered casually as he stood still. “Mom grew vegetables, and dad was a fisherman. No barns in sight.”

“Close enough,” Mydei mused, ignoring the gaming device on his couch to keep walking towards him. “Let me see what you’ve got first, Phainon. The winner gets to pick dinner.”

His heart skipped, and he nodded quickly as he took a step backwards. “I want fish,” he decided.

“I want lamb.” His best friend shrugged. “If you win, we will cook fish. If I win, I will cook lamb chops.”

“Deal.”

Phainon was not going to lose this time, not when cooking beside him was on the table as a reward.

Phainon had a lot to think about the next few days.

Between focusing on work, his roommate coming back from her trip, and the new things he was experiencing in secret at Mydei’s home, there was almost too much on his mind.

Sometimes he stayed the night when he shouldn’t just so they could work out in the morning and fall asleep together at night. They didn’t even watch movies sometimes, just slipped right into the mattress once the clock struck bedtime. Both he and Mydei shared one now, and there was no more staying up watching funny online videos until the early A.M hours. That wasn’t a sustainable habit when he was up at sunrise every morning.

It could be exhausting, and today was exhausting.

He had been talked down to by customers for things he wasn’t even at fault for—like prices on the menu and the chefs mistaking an order he wrote down clearly. A man whistled at him like a dog to get his attention when he was busy with another table. An older woman kept calling him ‘pretty boy’ and talking about how he was practically born for customer service with a face like his. All of it made him sick.

His muscles were sore from pushing himself a little too hard when working out, and his feet ached from being on them all day.

But he went to Mydei anyway.

Phainon took the parking spot he always did, and he walked the path he did every evening. The receptionist knew him by now, smiling as he walked by and waving flirtatiously when he smiled back.

It felt like a lot of people were suddenly looking at him, but he wasn’t as interested in dating as he used to be. Not when his days and nights were already so full of other things.

How was he meant to have a relationship when he was knee deep in this mutual arrangement with Mydei? There was still so much he didn't know and wanted to try, and there was no point if it wasn’t him.

As he knocked on his door, body leaned to the doorframe for support, he listened intently for the twisting lock. He watched his best friend look at him soon enough, a glass of liquor in hand and his work clothes undone. Even his usual braid had been unraveled, leaving behind only the lightly patterned locks.

“Mm… Would my sweet boy like a drink?"

“I’d like the entire bottle please, master,” he joked, walking to the foyer and allowing him to shut the door behind him. “I could use the de-stressing.”

Phainon bent over, unlaced his shoes routinely, and then slipped them onto a rack carefully. Afterwards, he followed behind his best friend.

“Cyrene comes home tomorrow,” he brought up casually. “She blew my phone up to remind me to kick my girlfriends out.”

“Tell her to text when she leaves and gets here, then that you don’t have a girlfriend,” he said back as they made their way to his bedroom. “Will she be arriving in the morning or evening?”

“Evening, so I won’t be able to come over. Maybe you can drop by our place?” He suggested hopefully. “She won’t mind seeing you. To be honest, I bet she’s going to come back and demand we throw this ‘welcome home’ thing for her. That girl loves a big social gathering, especially if all of our friends show up.”

“Sounds like someone I know.”

“Ha. Ha. She’s definitely more sociable than me.”

Mydei leaned against the door of his bathroom while looking at him, glass raised to his lips but not yet tilted back for a drink. Those rich, golden eyes looked him down like they always did, taking in the sight of his less-than-impressive uniform before lifting to his face. He studied him for a moment, searching his eyes for something.

“How do you feel?” He asked suddenly, then took a slight sip of the caramel-colored drink in his hand.

Phainon walked up to him, and he gently cupped the hand stretched around his glass.

“Can I please have a drink of yours, master?” He whispered, holding his eye contact. “I had a long day, but it’ll get better with you here.”

“Open.”

His lips parted, and he felt his best friend bring his glass closer until the opposite edge of the rim touched his lip. Ice made it cool, but the smooth whiskey sliding down his tongue and throat burned. He had to be good. He had to abide by every rule, take the utmost care of himself, and say all the right things to make him happy if he wanted to see him in that matching harness. It would be difficult, but he had to.

Every part of him craved to see him in the outfits he liked and felt good in, even if it was bondage gear and made up of leather and metal. Just knowing it was something that made him happy to do made Phainon want to be a part of it too. It could be theirs to share, no one else’s.

It matched his collar, and he wanted it even if he had to bite his tongue and bow his head.
