Mydei shook his head slowly. “I can’t accept that it wasn’t also my fault. I fell for his goading antics to rough him up and the promises that he wanted what I did.”

Phainon, truthfully, disliked the way he internalized blame sometimes. It irked him to hear the way he talked about himself, like he was the one fingers should be pointed at for everything that went wrong in his life.

Mydei was cheated on, but somehow that was his fault for not… what? Going out every weekend? Showing someone off to all his friends and family? Things Mydei explicitly tells everyone he meets—that he dislikes big, social events and doesn’t share intimate details of his life, was suddenly a deal breaker to someone who most likely knew that from the start?

“The only thing I could ever agree with that guy on is you have a tendency to do things for other people without consulting them,” he said, and Mydei looked up at him. “You tried to push me out the door without giving me a chance to talk too.”

“He said that?”

“Yeah, so I can guess how he reacted to you telling him to go find what he needs. Especially if you didn’t even give him a warning beforehand,” he added, aware that Mydei could have possibly just broken it off without ever talking about it.

Seeing his submissive looking happier without him, watching him break his rules so freely, and realizing they were incompatible would have given him enough to not even require a talk. Or, to him, maybe the talks came after all the rule breaking. Those punishments were the warnings, but to someone who didn’t want to be his submissive all the time, they were probably just kinky little scoldings from ‘daddy’.

It wasn't fair. Not to Mydei who wanted a specific kind of relationship. Not to that other guy who craved something more. The whole situation sounded like it could’ve been avoided if they just talked.

Their eyes met, and Phainon’s fingers reached to tuck the golden hair from Mydei’s face. Those soft, amber eyes were full of vulnerability, looking up at him like he was ready for him to call him ‘immature’ for a break up over the phone or ‘boring’ like his ex did. But Phainon would never unless joking with him the way they did as friends.

“You can say you were incompatible, and that can be true too, but it wasn’t just that. No matter how different the two of you are, that doesn’t justify playing with your feelings after agreeing to a certain kind of relationship with you,” he said gently, sick to his stomach at the thought that someone would willingly try to use him.

Even his worst mistake couldn’t justify something like being cheated on and blamed for it.

“He could’ve talked to you about his feelings instead of messing around with other people because you didn’t feel the same,” he added. “But I bet he liked free shopping sprees and kinky sex, so he never wanted to risk that talk of feelings.”

“Let’s not talk about it anymore.” Phainon nodded, then leaned forward to press a kiss against Mydei’s exposed forehead. “What happened after him, Phainon?”

“You were angry and dragged me out to the bathroom,” he said quietly, recalling the events for him. “You told me I was yours, and you were sick of people acting like they could boss me around or touch me so freely. That was when you demanded that I grind on you all night. You kissed me, grabbed me, and rubbed up against me in front of everyone—even our friends.”

“Oh…”

His stomach dropped over the sharp intake of breath that followed.

“I’m… sorry.” Mydei pulled away from him to put some distance between them, both hands holding his own arms instead. “D-Did I… pressure you to do anything else with me?”

Phainon’s eyes widened.

“… Huh?”

‘Pressure’? Did he think he didn’t have a choice in anything that happened?

“I bet you didn’t want any of that, right? When you go out, you just want to have fun with everyone, and there I was forcing you to shake your ass on me like some kind of creep. I’m going to be sick…” Mydei mumbled to himself, face pale as he shrunk in on himself again.

That was what he was worried about?

“No! No, I-I should be the one apologizing. I didn’t stop you from doing those things to me because I wanted you to,” he rushed to correct him, not wanting him to believe otherwise. “You didn’t ‘force’ me into anything, but I should have put my foot down and protected your privacy. I already knew you don’t like everyone knowing your business, yet I did it anyway.”

“Fuck my privacy—Phainon, did I hurt you?” He shot back. “Did I make you do anything you didn’t want to do? Was I really that demanding with you in a place where you couldn’t say ‘no’ without causing a scene?”

“No!” He repeated. “No, you didn’t hurt me. All we did was grind and kiss. No one got hurt, really, but… the girls have pictures and videos of us. They know we’re together. They know you’re fucking me. They know our business because I let them.”

This wasn’t how it was supposed to go.

He was the one who was supposed to feel bad. He was the sober guy letting his drunken partner get himself into situations he’d never be in while sober. This wasn’t about Mydei being pushy—he was always a but pushy, and that was attractive. It was about him being selfish about his own desires and disregarding what Mydei would’ve wanted.

“Are you trying to cover up for me right now? What if you safeworded, only for me to—”

“I didn’t. Not once.” Mydei exhaled shakily over the confession, nodding slowly while taking it in. “I didn’t even think about it because I wanted so badly to have you all to myself for a bit. Everyone got to hang out with you, and I wanted a turn with you too. I wanted a moment for it to be just us.”

“Promise I didn’t force you into anything?”

“I promise,” he swore. “You know I’ll tell you ‘no’ if I don’t want it. You know I find you attractive when you tell me what you want from me and take it.”

They looked at each other, and a smile slowly broke out on both of their faces the longer their silence stretched on. Regardless of what happened, it seemed he was more focused on Mydei, but Mydei was focused on him.

Together, they sighed in unison.

“Then we made this bed together,” Mydei decided as he lowered his arms. “Your selfishness and my recklessness let everyone find out about us, and that’s both of our faults.”

Phainon couldn’t argue with that.

“I’m sorry I put you in a spot for everyone to bombard us with questions and gossip,” Phainon apologized. “Our secret didn’t last very long, did it? If you want, I can do the talking if they ask. You don’t need to tell them anything if you don’t wanna.”

“No, I’m sorry I caused such a commotion in front of everyone last night. I should have been more responsible with my drinking, ate more to soak it up, and saved us both the trouble. Having no recollection of even getting home last night is unacceptable,” he said back, rose dusting his cheeks from embarrassment.

“Do you care that they know?”

Mydei hummed thoughtfully, tracing over his expression before shaking his head.

“It’s not that I think they’ll be unaccepting of us. Our friends are just loud, noisy, and too curious for their own good. They’ll pry.” Phainon’s eyebrow raised. “You should understand that. You’re exactly like that too.”

“Hey, I’m not just your ‘friend’ to talk to like that,” he mouthed off, reaching to poke his forehead and push him back. “We’ve had sex, and I held your hair back as you puked up liquor. Put some respect on my name, okay?”

“Oh, dear, sweet prince of mine, you are loud, and nosy, and pry where you don’t belong,” he repeated, and they shared a laugh. “It’s a hassle to tell people and let them know, then they’ll always be curious of how it’s going, what we’re doing, when are we going to take it to the next step, and so on and so forth. That’s all. You all have the biggest mouths on you, so I didn’t foresee us keeping this relationship quiet for long once we told Cyrene.”

“Last I checked, you liked this mouth of mine,” he taunted him.

Mydei’s eyebrow raised. “If you have any oral remedies for a migraine, I might like it even more.”

He gasped over the insinuation, and Mydei smiled back at him when he pushed on his chest. Before his hand could move, however, a firm grasp wrapped around his forearm. It pulled him closer, easing him out of his chair and on to his feet in front of him.

“Nasty,” Phainon accused him, voice lowered. “I should put you in time-out.”

“You should tell me how it felt to be my good boy in front of all our friends,” he whispered back. “Sounds to me you did everything I asked of you. What was that like for you in public?”

“Exciting.” Mydei glanced down to his lips. “Have I told you how attractive it is when you’re assertive? Especially when defending me?”

He chuckled. “Am I your knight in shining armor?”

Phainon’s eyes rolled before dropping to his mouth, watching the way they stretched from their own grin.

“Try tight little Calvin Kleins,” he mocked, reminded of how bare his body was as his hand slowly slid down his chest. “I can wake up to this every morning though. That’s not a complaint.”

“Give me a kiss, and I’ll give you whatever you want.”

The hand not holding his arm cupped his cheek, and Phainon tilted into the touch. Mydei’s soft thumb traced over the rounded apple as he smiled softly, pinching to pull him forward by the face.

As their noses brushed, Phainon let his eyelids droop a little. Then, he shut them all together. It was at that moment he realized just how tired his eyes were and how good it felt to close them.

“And… if I want you to hold me while I take a tiny little nap?” He murmured, melting into his warm and gentle touch.

“Then I will put on a movie, lay down in bed, and hold you the way you like while you sleep.”

Instead of responding with words, his lips brushed over Mydei’s eagerly. They smelled faintly minty from his mouth wash, and he was beyond happy he didn’t taste like liquor and bile from last night now that he actually thought about it. But this was also Mydei, who hated feeling gross or dirty in any kind of way.

Of course his first concerns of the morning would be his breath and the missing spot in his bed.

The hand on his chest inched closer to the left side, cupping over his pec to give a cheeky squeeze.

“Phainon!” Mydei chided, and he hummed before kissing him again. “Mmph—!”

“Revenge for last night,” he whispered.

But even with the scolding, he didn’t stop him. He let him touch his body, squeeze his body, and kiss him deeper after his tongue swiped over his bottom lip. They touched, brushing over one another’s briefly.

Before Mydei could push even closer, Phainon eased away, saliva stringing their mouths together. Soft breaths clouded between them.

“Let’s be good. None of that.” As much as he wanted to keep going, it was probably best to save it for when he wasn’t hungover and they didn’t have someone in the guest bedroom. “Please eat. I cooked a lot for you and Cifera.”

As their eyes met again, Phainon gave his chest another squeeze.

“You’re still groping me.”

“It’s still revenge for putting a finger over my crack,” he brushed off, leaning into his neck and shoulder as Mydei removed the hand from his face. A clink sounded from his fork tapping the plate. “Is this actually comfortable for you?”

“Very,” he reassured him. “Here. I want you to take a few bites for me.”

His head shook. “Not hungry. ‘m more sleepy.”

“You may sleep after you eat a little bit,” Mydei instructed, and he huffed quietly while raising his head. “Don’t get an attitude with me right now. Did you get to eat last night? Be honest with me.”

His silence made Mydei scoff.

“That’s unacceptable. You eating is non-negotiable now, Phainon. You know how I feel about you skipping meals.”

Phainon shifted, opening his mouth to accept the bite. Potatoes, eggs, sausage, Mydei waited as he chewed and swallowed it all down. By the time he finished, another forkful was waiting for him to take.

“I’m never drinking like that again,” he promised after. “Knowing how neglectful I was to your needs makes me feel terrible, so let me do this for you. Let me tend to you now that I can.”

“Why did you?” He asked before accepting the second bite.

“Father kept blowing up my phone. Usually I mute it, but… he sent more than what he usually did.” Phainon guessed as much. “He was pouring his heart out in my messages, so I didn’t have the heart to mute it. Then our friends were there, and I wanted to be fun.”

“Mm… I saw him text you.”

An accusatory grumble followed. “You went through my—”

“No, I saw the wall of texts when you left your phone open on the counter. I promise I didn’t read any,” he cut him off, and Mydei was silent while mulling over his explanation. “I figured you’d tell me if it mattered enough… I wouldn’t ever pry that far into your business.”

He sighed. “It’s just the same thing he always tells me. Time is money, and I need to hang out with him more so we can talk about my future.”

“Maybe you should,” he gave his two-cents on the topic. “I know he kinda forced this career on you, and maybe he’s not the best person, but… that is your dad. Him trying so hard has to count for something, right? You love him, and I’m positive he loves you even if it’s… complicated…”

“He won’t like you.” The abrupt statement made his stomach drop. “As my friend? Yes. As my lover? No. He’ll tell you he has nothing against our lifestyle, and he wishes us well for the sake of pleasantries, but he has always secretly held out hope of me ‘giving it up’ and finding a woman.”

Oh…

His lips sealed, and he turned away from the next bite of food, too busy digesting the information to eat anymore so soon.

Well, Phainon can’t say he was surprised. He guessed as much from what he heard of their past conversation. Even if most of him had hoped it was a misunderstanding, a small part just… knew.

“He wants me to be like him. I should have a sweet, loving wife and a son waiting on me when I get home from work every night.” Mydei lowered the fork. “I should work as much as possible, give my life and wealth to my wife and son, and set him up to have the same life my father did for me. That’s the point of life—family and success.”

Phainon scoffed. “You can’t control things like that. You don’t like women, and what would he do if you had a daughter instead?”

“I’d have to keep trying for a son. They got lucky, that’s why I’m an only child,” he answered as if it were that simple.

“I’m sorry,” was all he could think to say.

“Don’t be,” Mydei brushed off. “I’m already taking on this career path for him to honor the hard work we both put into it, but that’s as much as I’m allowing him to take from me. Everything outside of work belongs to me.”

“Like me?” He teased, hoping to lighten the mood, and Mydei nodded.

“Yes, my prince. I won’t let you go for anything. I almost made that mistake before, but never again,” he promised him. “I’ll… call him later, I guess. Maybe we can get lunch with mother next weekend, and he’ll hop off for a while.”

“Maybe it’ll go better with her there…?”

“Maybe. Mother often says we’re alike in many ways, that’s why we clash so much with each other,” Mydei admitted. “You do too, actually. Apparently we both have a habit of thinking we know best, then not asking others before we make decisions for them.”

Phainon looked down, made aware of the fork being brought back up for him. This time, he took a bite to keep from having to respond.

“You know, you make me talk too much.” Amber eyes watched as he chewed, distant as if thinking of something else entirely. “All I do is complain around you. Do I ever shut up anymore?”

“Maybe you’re just realizing it’s really not fair,” he pointed out, only for that same fork to poke his bottom lip as a scolding for talking with a full mouth.

“Hush. Eat, then let me put you to sleep for a nap,” he ordered weakly. “I need a moment of silence now, okay?”

He nodded in understanding, then swallowed. “Yes, master. If you need me, talk to me.”

“I love you,” Mydei murmured, kissing his cheek gently. “Thank you for everything.”

Phainon rested on his shoulder again, relaxing against his body as they ate in a comfortable silence. He had taken care of him all night, and he’d do it again in a heartbeat because he loved him. But it was kind of nice to be pampered again, especially as the exhaustion hit him like a truck.

In the following days, Mydei wasn't particularly in any kind of sexual or playfully suggestive mood. Phainon noticed that when talking to him on the phone and texting him.

When he tried to hint at things through their calls, they tossed it back and forth between them but no pictures or videos were sent like before. At one point, just before going for a shower, he made a sly remark about Mydei wanting to join. Mydei only told him his shower wasn’t big enough for them both. Which, yeah, but it was supposed to be sexy talk to make him send something a little more risqué.

It didn’t feel like outright denial of his advances, but almost like Mydei wasn’t comfortable with it. After all, he knew his partner liked being with him, and he knew he was never against any suggestive moves he made. But as the gossip from their friends continued and deepened, he only ever told him he’d ‘think about it’ the next time they met up, then left it at that.

Part of him understood. Hyacine had told Cyrene and Castorice what she remembered when they woke up, and Cifera found out from him after screeching over the photo of them kissing in their group chat. It had been almost a week, yet they were still poking fun at how even the cool and composed Mydei had that side of him—a wild, sexy, and ‘exhibitionist’ side of him. All words coined by each of their friends.

Phainon tried so hard to deny it, to blame the alcohol and the vibes of everyone else doing it, but then they’d turn around and say he was a pervert. He was so into Mydei grabbing him and bossing him around that it was sickening. They could only imagine the things they got into while alone after that.

To Castorice, it was cute that Mydei had someone to dote on when he was such a gentle person. She sent a paragraph about how she was so happy he had someone to give flowers to besides his mother. Not that either of them chose to correct her on how Mydei had never given him flowers before.

For Cyrene who already knew, it was absolutely hilarious to her that this was how they let everyone find out about them. It didn't even come from his mouth, but from the more secretive of them quite literally kissing on him in public. Oh how reckless of them.

In Cifera’s eyes, she was glad someone else was going to face the brunt end of Mydei’s poking and prodding. With him as his lover, he couldn’t keep bothering her when all she wanted to do was play games and do her own thing. But Mydei better not bring him over her house all the time, she didn’t need three babysitters on her.

And Hyacine congratulated them. She teased him for being a sucker for Mydei and letting him do whatever he wanted with him. That was sweet of him to do, though. Allowing him to let loose a bit and then taking such good care of him after was proof of how much he loved him and understood him.

But Mydei was beyond annoyed that it was their hot topic, going as far as to mute the group chat entirely whenever they kicked the conversation back up. Those screenshots were texted to him when he did it, and sometimes he grumbled about it during their calls too, saying he couldn’t stand this but didn’t want to dull their fun. It wasn’t often anyone in their group got involved with someone, as they’ve all been mostly single all their lives—well, except Mydei. But no one else really knew that besides him.

On Friday night, Phainon decided to visit again. The week was long, and he just wanted to be with Mydei to cool off after an even longer day at work. His partner agreed under the premise Cyrene wouldn’t giggle about their visit to the other girls in secret.

He slipped his shoes off like he usually did after unlocking the door. A smile tugged on his lips when the warm scent of fresh herbs and sizzling meat filled his nose. Immediately, his shoulders relaxed as if he were coming back to his own home.

“Phainon? Is that you?”

“No, it’s an intruder,” he called back sarcastically, walking into the kitchen as a scoff followed. “Master, I had the worst day at work. It was so miserable.”

Mydei turned around from the stove, looking over his shoulder as he approached.

“Hello to you too, intruder,” he said back, a light tilt to his low voice. “What happened today? Talk to me.”

Phainon came up behind him, both arms wrapping around his waist so he could hide inside the nape of his neck. They curled as deep as possible, fists grasping at his cooking apron to lock his partner in place. His forehead pressed into his shoulder, and his eyes closed while taking a deep breath to steel himself.

It took a moment to find the words and the strength to actually talk, but once he did, he started with a frustrated groan.

“Some people just… Earlier, an older lady tried blaming me for a hair in her food. Am I colorblind? Do I actually have black hair?” He asked, and Mydei hummed thoughtfully while listening to him. “Do I have black hair anywhere in my body? Like… anywhere?”

“I can confirm that it is, in fact, natural,” he agreed, giving a stir to what he was cooking. “That nice, snowy hair is all over your handsome body. Not a black hair in sight.”

“Yeah, right? Then she said it was the chef’s. Most of the chefs there either have gray hair or are bald! The closest person with black hair is Hysilens, and she’s at the bar,” Phainon ranted, holding him tighter. “Oh, and then this couple brought their kid. First of all, no one ever really brings their kid to a restaurant like this. Second of all, they sat the kid at the end of the booth, perfect for him to knock his plate off the table as he threw a tantrum over his chicken not being the right kind of chicken! Who does that? And what does that even mean? Chicken is chicken, isn’t it? I gave them exactly what they ordered! But it’s my fault their kid is picky, messy, and ill-mannered? As if! But I had to smile, apologize, and deal with it anyway.”

Mydei clicked the stove off, and the spatula he had in hand clicked to a dish.

“That sounds like a real headache… Come here, handsome. Do you want to be held?”

“Mhm… Yes, please.”

His arms loosened, allowing Mydei to shift within them. He turned around to face him completely rather than keeping that half twisted stance, and Phainon accepted his warm hug while resting over his collar. While tucked into his partner’s neck, he could physically feel his body melting into him as that familiar, worn out cologne filled his lungs.

Mydei was always warm and comforting, but there was something about his strong arms holding him tightly that made things feel as if they’d be okay. Like he was born to protect, support, and take care of the people around him.

Just a few seconds in his embrace and Phainon was already feeling better.

“Sounds like you had an awfully stressful shift. Allow me to help you unwind,” he offered, speaking softly. “How are you feeling tonight? I’ll do whatever my prince wants me to.”

A shiver trickled up his spine over the routine question, and a tickle of interest burned in his belly from the possibilities. When asking that, then following it up with a statement like that, a million things popped into his head at once.

Biting into his lip, he lowered his hands down Mydei’s back to grip the loops of his work pants.

“I’m good. If you’re offering, I’ll bite,” he hinted sheepishly, nervous of his own anticipation. “It’s uh… been awhile since you last… touched me, you know… So I’d like that a lot.”

“Would you?” He double-checked. “If you’re too tired, then we don’t have to.”

Phainon nodded his head quickly. “Yeah, please? The last time you did anything to me, I know you don’t really remember it because you were wasted, but you went and did this…”

One hand lowered, sliding over Mydei’s ass to cup the left cheek inside of his palm. The sudden action ripped a surprised gasp from his partner’s lips.

“Wh-What the hell are you doing?”

“… and you did this…”

His middle finger slipped between either cheek, curling with the natural curve of his bottom. It hooked over his crack loosely, not nearly as tight as Mydei had done it to him while drunk, but still reminiscent of the gesture.

“… then you pressed your bulge into my ass all night long,” Phainon added. His finger didn’t move an inch. “You even told me you wanted to spank me in front of everyone, then pouted when I didn’t let you.”

Part of him kind of wanted to be spanked again. The few he had given him in the past were so exciting, and Mydei liked to tell him he would do it.

Could they try it tonight? Should he ask for it, or would Mydei just give it to him if he kept this up?

“Get your finger away from my ass before I bend you over and actually spank you,” Mydei warned him, his voice low and rich with promise.

There it was.

Phainon still didn’t move his finger, curious of if he’d actually commit to it this time.

“Three seconds, Phainon. One.”

His heart skipped, and excitement pumped through his veins as he slid his finger higher up the back of his pants. But that wasn’t taking it off. He knew that.

“Two,” Mydei continued with his countdown, and the lowered number made him giddy. “Don’t do this. I have to spend the day with my father tomorrow, so I’ve got no patience for disobedience right now.”

It stayed there, holding him, testing him.

“O—”

Phainon lifted it the moment he heard the first letter, but it was too late. Not that he expected Mydei to be lenient with his threat and start counting by halves.

“—ne.”

A rough hand gripped his chin in hand and pinched it tightly, lifting it from the safety of his partner’s collar to meet the amber eyes staring him down. The eyebrows above were pinched together with frustration, and the lips below were pursed tightly to finish the look. Rose tinted his cheeks.

“Here’s what’s going to happen…” Mydei lowered his voice to a firm but quiet tone. Shivers crawled up his spine. “You’re going to take a shower, and you’re going to clean yourself up.”

He gulped over the emphasis.

“I’m going to do the things I usually do—make dinner, prepare your pajamas, collar you…” The list went on, Phainon knew it all well by now. “Before we eat, I’m going to touch you, and I'm not going to ask before I do. I’m going to punish you, and you’re going to take it. After we finish, you can then enjoy your dinner sitting on a cold compress or standing up at the table. That wholeheartedly depends on how well you can take it.”

Tingles inched throughout his body at the thought of Mydei actually spanking him the way he’s always wanted to. Time and time again he threatened him, and yet he only ever gave him a single swat here or there. Maybe it was to keep from crossing any boundaries, which was sweet. But his curiosity was a dangerous thing.

What would a proper spanking from his dominant be like? Was he really about to find out tonight?

“Have I made myself clear enough for you, Phainon? Speak,” he ordered him, giving another tug to his chin.

Phainon cleared his throat, shaking himself from his thoughts. “Y-Yes, master. Crystal clear.”

“Repeat to me what you're going to do. Verbatim.”

“I-I’m going to take a shower, and I’m going to clean myself up, master,” he repeated for him, earning a nod in response. “After, I’ll eat dinner with you.”

“Any questions?” Mydei asked. “Is there anything I should know about before I send you off? Do any safewords come to mind? Are there any concerns you need to share?”

“Can you please make us ice cream to eat as we cuddle on the couch?” He blurted out, and a flash of confusion crossed his partner’s previously firm gaze. “I want cookies and cream. Can you do that, please?”

“… Excuse me?”

“I want ice cream please,” he said again, innocent despite the hot water he was in.

He was right where he wanted to be, so all he could think of was after everything went down. While he was showering, Mydei could make it, and when they finished dinner, it would be ready to share. That made sense to him.

“… If you don’t make a mess on my couch, then I guess it isn’t trouble. I’ll make us some ice cream,” Mydei allowed, sounding a bit confused. “That wasn’t what I meant though.”

“It’s the only concern I have right now,” he admitted to him honestly. “You know I have a sweet tooth, and after a long day, I want sweets.”

“Then go shower, and take your time washing up. But if you take too long to try and escape your punishment, I’ll go get you myself.”

There was a warning in those words, but that was one Phainon wasn't ready to test. Being walked in on during that kind of shower would be mortifying. It would ruin the mood completely.

“Being kinky is one way to relieve stress after a long day, huh?” He teased him, holding on to an air of playfulness.

The hand on his jaw raised to come down over his cheek. A soft click of skin meeting skin filled the kitchen, and a light tingle burned in its wake as he leaned into his palm. Its warmth and strength was comforting, exciting, and nerve wracking all at once.

“Go, spoiled brat,” Mydei instructed him. “If I have to say it again, I’m going to slap you again.”

“Kiss first, master?”

“No,” he shut down, and another tap nudged his face away from his hand. Phainon’s jaw dropped from the rejection. “And that hurts me more than it hurts you, you know. So be on your best behavior if you want a kiss at all tonight.”

He pouted, then nodded solemnly.

“My master doesn’t like me, I get it…” He sulked. Amber eyes rolled before giving him another smack on the cheek. “No kisses from my master… I guess I’ll just go be all by myself then…”

Phainon had been bad the night before, and he knew that. His attitude was everywhere, going as far as to make Mydei not only slap his cheek but spank his ass. And as fun as it was to try something new or get him a little bit worked up, he knew better than to keep walking that same disobedient path. There was a time and a place to push buttons, and he exhausted both already.

When waking up that next morning and starting their day together, he was careful of being overly bratty. If Mydei said something to him, it was already done before he could turn around. After all, Phainon liked to be helpful. He liked to be good for him and get completely pampered by him in return.

Mydei told him to put the basket full of dirty towels in the wash once he finished rinsing off, so he did. And because Mydei was going to meet his parents for brunch and to spend the day with them, he only had a small meal for breakfast. But he still demanded that he eat a full meal, so Phainon still had dishes to wash. Those were then taken care of swiftly in the way Mydei liked.

Once finished, he joined his partner in the bedroom. His knuckles tapped to the door even if the mirror in his closet showed him standing there, and Mydei glanced his way briefly.

“Phainon, pick a shirt.”

Since it was a demand, he did that too after looking between the options.

“I like the blue and gold one, master. It matches your jewelry,” he commented. “You look good in red, but you wear red a lot. Let’s retire it for a day.”

“For once, your fashion advice makes sense,” he mused, and Phainon rolled his eyes. “Thank you.”

“Happy to help, master.”

Both hands took the chosen shirt from him as Mydei reached to tuck the hangers back in their spot. He worked the buttons open for him, then silently helped him fit arm after arm into either sleeve.

“Will you be here for dinner tonight, master?” Phainon wondered, eyes locked on to the way his under-shirt hugged his thick waist.

“I don’t intend on staying any longer than necessary. We’re going for a meal, then my father wants to talk to me over golf,” he shared, an edge of annoyance in his usually cool tone. “I plan to be home.”

“Would you like me to be here for you when you do?”

Mydei hesitated, mulling the thought over as Phainon’s fingers worked the buttons of his shirt slowly. “If you have plans, or if plans come up, you don’t need to be here. I’m not going to demand you waste the day all by yourself and wait like a dog by the door. That’s ridiculous.”

Phainon pouted slightly. “But do you wanna see me here, master?”

All he needed to do was say ‘yes’. Cyrene knew they were together. She was aware that he needed to be here for some alone time with him, and she promised that she didn’t see it as a way to dodge hanging out with her. Why keep trying to beat around the bush?

If Mydei wanted him somewhere, he would be there. That was all that needed to be said.

“It’s not necessary to wait up.”

Taking a breath, Phainon lightly pulled on his shirt while looking into his eyes.

“Master, please listen. Do you want to come home to your sub waiting for you?” He asked one last time, slower than before, and Mydei’s eyes dropped.

Another moment of contemplation passed. He watched as those rosy lips were licked over and chewed on.

“I know myself. I’ll probably be in a bad mood, and you shouldn’t have to deal with my short temper unnecessarily. You’re my submissive, not my therapist,” he explained himself and his answer.

A smile tugged over Phainon’s lips as he cupped his freshly shaved jaw. Both thumbs touched the corners of his lips, and he pushed them higher.

“Then I just have to try extra hard to make my master feel better, or give him something nice to smile about when he gets home,” he said simply. “Here’s what I’m thinking, but tell me if you wanna change anything, okay?”

“Hm…”

“I can cook us dinner.”

Mydei already had an eyebrow raised, skeptical of his offer because cooking for them was a job he liked to do. He cooked their meals, baked their desserts, and pressed their juices. While Phainon was allowed to give suggestions for meals, snacks, or flavors, Mydei did as he pleased in those areas. And it worked for them.

Already, he seemed slightly against the idea.

“I’ll have a delicious meal ready when you get back, dress up nice and handsome for a little eye candy, and be on my very best behavior for you. You can have all the control you want from me, and I’ll obey every word even better than I already do,” he offered to him.

Mydei shook the hands on his face off, then raked his eyes over his pleased and proud expression.

"That’s very… domestic…” He commented, and Phainon nodded happily.

He really did like the domestic things they did together. Chores were never too boring with Mydei around, and they doubled as a way to be both dominant and submissive for each other. He could boss him around a little bit, Phainon could be praised for a job well done, and everyone was happy with that arrangement.

Even at the start when this was new, he enjoyed getting to take care of the little things for him like dishes and laundry.

“Domestic roleplay," he joked, earning a light chuckle in response. “It’s… relaxing for you, isn’t it? Don’t you wanna come home then not have to think about a single thing but you and me?”

“If that’s the case, may I ask something of you? If it’s a little outrageous, tell me.”

“Yeah, anything you want,” he encouraged him. “I’m just spitballing things. What are you thinking, master?”

Leaning in, Mydei brought his mouth up to his ear. Lips touched the lobe, and a breath fanned across the skin while pulling him chest to chest. The words whispered to him made warmth spread over his face and his breathing to hitch while taking them in. Then, he nodded softly.

“Yeah, o-okay,” he whispered back shakily. “I uh… I can definitely do that.”

“Good boy,” Mydei purred, the sound low, rich, and silky. It enveloped his senses, tingling in his gut and his groin as it wrapped around him and his head. “Do you have any plans today? Or are you going to hang out around here until I get back?”

“I’d like to go out and buy a nice outfit for you. Maybe something you haven’t seen before so it’s more exciting to come back to,” he brought up thoughtfully.

Mydei kissed beneath his ear before pulling back slightly. “I want to buy you a little iced coffee or iced tea while you walk around then.”

Phainon sighed, both in pleasure and in resignation. “Do you really?”

“Yes.”

“Fine, but only the drink,” he gave in on his own this time. Just that had Mydei grinning with pride. “And that’s because, as my lover, I can accept a little ten dollar drink. It’s not that bad, I guess…”

“I also pay for the groceries around here, so how much do you think you’ll need to cook dinner?” He asked, pulling back even further. “You can cook it if I can buy it. Otherwise, guess one of us is bringing home take out, or I’m making dinner when I get back.”

“But—”

“No. My house, my bills. How much?” Mydei pressed firmly, and Phainon pouted slightly over his pushiness.

“I haven’t really thought about what exactly…”

There were so many things he could make for them with all the time he’d have to cook. Did he really have to have it planned out this early in the day? Did Mydei always know what he was making for dinner this early in the day?

“I’ll give you something, and whatever’s left, I guess you can give it back to me.” With that, he turned to approach his jewelry case to end the discussion there. It was clear he had no intent on letting him both buy ingredients and cook them for him.

“I guess that sounds fair,” he caved, content with this arrangement. “Can I keep helping you get dressed?”

As much as he liked seeing him in just his boxers, watching him slowly get dressed layer after layer was nice. Picking his shirt, buttoning his clothes, and maybe even brushing his hair and helping him braid it sounded nice.

“Yes, I’d like that,” he agreed. Phainon joined him as he slid the case open to grab a watch. “Put this on me.”

He took it, unlatched the back, and slipped it over Mydei’s wrist as the other man continued to pick out what he wanted to wear. When on, a couple of smaller things like rings, earrings, and his usually braid cuff filled his hand.

“Is this how you feel when you pick my outfits? Fulfilled?”

“Yes, but I also do it so I know other people are going to look at you walking by like I do.” Phainon rolled his eyes as heat tickled through his face. “Not that you give them too much attention, right?”

“I mostly ignore the flirting and glancing at this point, master,” he reassured him. “I dress for you and your arrogance… or whatever I like when you’re not around to pick them.”

“Me and my arrogance indeed,” he murmured, looking down at his body briefly. “I’ll text you an hour before I leave, that should give you plenty of time to prepare yourself for me. I expect you to tell me otherwise if your feelings change throughout the day.”

“I’ll be ready, master,” he promised him, already planning his day out in his head. “I want it.”

He couldn’t wait for later tonight.

I… kinda like the feeling of stuff like this on my body. Maybe it’s from all the ropes and harnesses we play with, but it’s kinda nice.”

His fingers then gripped his shirt tighter as he averted his gaze. Suddenly, he felt a little bit shy from being so honest, like a large spotlight was beating down over him.

“I thought you’d like it. You said you liked chains if they're attached to a collar or clamps, but… I can’t really give you that without going way further out of my comfort zone,” his nervous rambling started up as he second guessed his choice. “Is this okay? Are you happy with this? It’s for a girl, but I guess I thought… I don’t… know…—it was pretty on the mannequin. I thought it’d be pretty on me too.”

“Shh…” Mydei hushed him gently. Soon, his hand reached forward to pull him closer by the waist. “Hey, just breathe for me, Phainon. Why are you so nervous?”

Phainon shrugged unsurely. “It’s kinda a girl thing, right? When I got it, the girl asked if I was buying it for my girlfriend. Is it weird that I’m wearing it? My prince did this all to please me, and he even took a step to try something new for me. Do you like it? Do you feel good about yourself?”

“I-I do, master.”

“Then I love it. I love the way the gold color matches your day collar, and I love how it brings so much attention to your chest,” he noticed, eyeing the accessory with a pleased look in his eye. “And this shirt is driving me crazy. His grin fell, and his bottom lip gave a little tremble as he brought his nose to the top. Breathing in the fresh and floral mist brought a little pit to his stomach.

These were expensive, and he knew it had to have been.

“Do you like them? Are they to your tastes, or should I have picked different flowers?” Mydei asked when he didn’t speak.

“They’re so beautiful.” Phainon looked up at him while holding them closer. “Master, thank you so much. I love them.”

Hearing that made Mydei smile proudly, and he leaned forward to press a chaste kiss against his lips.
